objectClass.name: HLAmanager
objectClass.semantics: This object class is the root class of all MOM object classes

objectClass.name: HLAfederate
objectClass.semantics:
This object class shall contain RTI state variables relating to a joined federate. The RTI shall publish it and shall register one object instance for each joined federate in a federation. Dynamic attributes that shall be contained in an object instance shall be updated periodically, where the period should be determined by an interaction of the class HLAmanager.HLAfederate.HLAadjust.HLAsetTiming. If this value is never set or is set to zero, no periodic update shall be performed by the RTI.
The RTI shall respond to the invocation, by any federate, of the Request Attribute Value Update service for this object class or for any instance attribute of an object instance of this class by supplying values via the normal instance attribute update mechanism, regardless of whether the attribute has a data type of static, periodic, or conditional. In addition to its responsibility to update attributes of object instances of this class when those updates are explicitly requested, the RTI shall automatically update instance attributes of object instances of this class according to the update policy of the attribute, which is determined by the update type of the class attribute in Table 6. For those attributes that have an update type of Periodic, the update wall-clock time interval shall be determined by the HLAreportPeriod parameter in an interaction of classHLAmanager.HLAfederate. HLAadjust.HLAsetTiming. If this value is never set or is set to zero, no periodic updates shall be performed by the RTI. Those attributes that have an update type of Conditional shall have update conditions as defined in the Table 6.

attribute.name: HLAfederateHandle
attribute.semantics: Handle of the joined federate returned by a Join Federation Execution service invocation

attribute.name: HLAfederateName
attribute.semantics: Name of the joined federate supplied to a successful Join Federation Execution service invocation

attribute.name: HLAfederateType
attribute.semantics: Type of the joined federate specified by the joined federate when it joined the federation

attribute.name: HLAfederateHost
attribute.semantics: Host name of the computer on which the joined federate is executing

attribute.name: HLARTIversion
attribute.semantics: Version of the RTI software being used

attribute.name: HLAFOMmoduleDesignatorList
attribute.semantics: FOM Module designators as specified by the federate when the Join Federation Execution service was invoked. If several identical FOM modules are provided only the designator of the first of these FOM modules shall be added to the list.

attribute.name: HLAtimeConstrained
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever services Time Constrained Enabled or Disable Time Constrained are successfully invoked (including via the HLAdisableTimeConstrained interaction).
attribute.semantics: Whether the time advancement of the joined federate is constrained by other joined federates

attribute.name: HLAtimeRegulating
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever services Time Regulation Enabled or Disable Time Regulation are successfully invoked (including via the HLAdisableTimeRegulation interaction).
attribute.semantics: Whether the joined federate influences the time advancement of other joined federates

attribute.name: HLAasynchronousDelivery
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever services Enable Asynchronous Delivery or Disable Asynchronous Delivery are successfully invoked (including via the HLAenableAsynchronousDelivery or HLAdisableAsynchronousDelivery interactions).
attribute.semantics: Whether the RTI shall deliver RO messages to the joined federate while the joined federate's time manager state is not "Time Advancing" (only matters if the joined federate is time-constrained).

attribute.name: HLAfederateState
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever the services Initiate Federate Save, Federation Saved, Federation Restore Begun, Confirm Federation Restoration Request (success), or Join Federation Execution are successfully invoked. Also, after the Federation Restored service has been invoked at all federates in the federation execution. If a joined federate is in the Federate Save in Progress state, no corresponding reflects shall be invoked at that joined federate.
attribute.semantics: State of the joined federate. The MOM may, but is not required to, update any HLAfederateState instance attribute values during the interval after the last federate in the federation execution invokes the Federate Restore Complete service but before the last Federation Restored † callback is invoked at some federate for a given federation restoration.

attribute.name: HLAtimeManagerState
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever services Time Advance Request, Time Advance Request Available, Next Message Request, Next Message Request Available, Flush Queue Request, or Time Advance Grant are successfully invoked (including via the HLAtimeAdvanceRequest, HLAtimeAdvanceRequestAvailable, HLAnextMessageRequest, HLAnextMessageRequestAvailable, or HLAflushQueueRequest interactions).
attribute.semantics: State of the joined federate's time manager

attribute.name: HLAlogicalTime
attribute.semantics: Joined federate's logical time. Initial value of this information is initial value of federation time of the Time Representation Abstract Data Type (TRADT).

attribute.name: HLAlookahead
attribute.semantics: Minimum duration into the future that a TSO message will be scheduled. The value shall not be defined if the joined federate is not time-regulating)

attribute.name: HLAGALT
attribute.semantics: Joined federate's Greatest Available Logical Time (GALT). The value shall not be defined if GALT is not defined for the joined federate.

attribute.name: HLALITS
attribute.semantics: Joined federate's Least Incoming Time Stamp (LITS). The value shall not be defined if LITS is not defined for the joined federate.

attribute.name: HLAROlength
attribute.semantics: Number of RO messages queued for delivery to the joined federate.

attribute.name: HLATSOlength
attribute.semantics: Number of TSO messages queued for delivery to the joined federate

attribute.name: HLAreflectionsReceived
attribute.semantics: Total number of times the Reflect Attribute Values † service has been invoked at the joined federate (as opposed to the number of instance attribute value reflections that have been received at the joined federate).

attribute.name: HLAupdatesSent
attribute.semantics: Total number of updates sent by the joined federate" in XML and "Total number of times the Update Attribute Values † service has successfully been invoked by the joined federate (as opposed to the number of instance attribute values that have been updated by the joined federate).

attribute.name: HLAinteractionsReceived
attribute.semantics: Total number of interactions received by the joined federate.

attribute.name: HLAinteractionsSent
attribute.semantics: Total number of interactions sent by the joined federate. This information shall reflect related DDM usage.

attribute.name: HLAobjectInstancesThatCanBeDeleted
attribute.semantics: Total number of object instances whose HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject attribute is owned by the joined federate

attribute.name: HLAobjectInstancesUpdated
attribute.semantics: Total number of object instances for which the joined federate has invoked the Update Attribute Values service.

attribute.name: HLAobjectInstancesReflected
attribute.semantics: Total number of object instances for which the joined federate has had a Reflect Attribute Values service invocation.

attribute.name: HLAobjectInstancesDeleted
attribute.semantics: Total number of times the Delete Object Instance service was invoked by the joined federate since the federate joined the federation

attribute.name: HLAobjectInstancesRemoved
attribute.semantics: Total number of times the Remove Object Instance service was invoked for the joined federate since the federate joined the federation.

attribute.name: HLAobjectInstancesRegistered
attribute.semantics: Total number of times the Register Object Instance or Register Object Instance with Region service were invoked by the joined federate since the federate joined the federation.

attribute.name: HLAobjectInstancesDiscovered
attribute.semantics: Total number of times the Discover Object Instance † service was invoked for the joined federate since the federate joined the federation.The value of the HLAobjectInstancesDiscovered attribute shall include multiple invocations of the Discover Object Instance † service for a given object instance that may occur as a result of invocation of the Local Delete Object Instance service at a federate.

attribute.name: HLAtimeGrantedTime
attribute.semantics: Wall clock time duration that the federate has spent in the Time Granted state since the last update of this attribute. When the HLAtimeGrantedTime and the HLAtimeAdvancingTime attributes are initially updated, their values shall be the wall-clock time duration that the federate has spent in the state since the federate has been joined to the federation execution.

attribute.name: HLAtimeAdvancingTime
attribute.semantics: Wall clock time duration that the federate has spent in the Time Advancing state since the last update of this attribute. When the HLAtimeGrantedTime and the HLAtimeAdvancingTime attributes are initially updated, their values shall be the wall-clock time duration that the federate has spent in the state since the federate has been joined to the federation execution.

attribute.name: HLAconveyRegionDesignatorSets
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever the HLAmanager.HLAfederate.HLAfederate.HLAadjust.HLAsetSwitches interaction is sent to successfully change the value of the HLAconveyRegionDesignatorSets parameter.
attribute.semantics: Value of joined federate's Convey Region Designator Sets Switch. Updated when value of switch changes

attribute.name: HLAconveyProducingFederate
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever the HLAmanager.HLAfederate.HLAfederate.HLAadjust.HLAsetSwitches interaction is sent to successfully change the value of the HLAconveyProducingFederate parameter.
attribute.semantics: Value of joined federate's Convey Producing Federate Switch. Updated when value of switch changes

objectClass.name: HLAfederation
objectClass.semantics: This object class shall contain RTI state variables relating to a federation execution. The RTI shall publish it and shall register one object instance for the federation execution. The RTI shall respond to the invocation, by any federate, of the Request Attribute Value Update service for this object class or for any instance attribute of an object instance of this class by supplying values via the normal instance attribute update mechanism, regardless of whether the attribute has a data type of static or conditional. In addition to its responsibility to update attributes of object instances of this class when those updates are explicitly requested, the RTI shall automatically update instance attributes of object instances of this class according to the update policy of the attribute, which is determined by the update type of the class attribute in Table 6. Those attributes that have an update type of Conditional shall have update conditions as defined in the Table 6.

attribute.name: HLAfederationName
attribute.semantics: Name of the federation to which the joined federate belongs

attribute.name: HLAfederatesInFederation
attribute.semantics: Identifiers of joined federates that are joined to the federation

attribute.name: HLARTIversion
attribute.semantics: Version of the RTI software

attribute.name: HLAMIMdesignator
attribute.semantics: Designator associated with the MIM specified in the Create Federation Execution service invocation. In case the RTI has supplied the standard MIM, the designator shall be “HLAstandardMIM”.

attribute.name: HLAFOMmoduleDesignatorList
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever new FOM modules are added by Create Federation Execution and Join Federation Execution service invocations.
attribute.semantics: FOM Module designators for the federation as specified in the Create Federation Execution service and Join Federation Execution invocations. If several identical FOM modules are provided only the designator for the first of these FOM modules shall be added to the list.

attribute.name: HLAcurrentFDD
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever the Current FOM subset is modified by Create Federation Execution and Join Federation Execution service invocations.
attribute.semantics: The Current FDD realized as a result of antecedent successful Create Federation Execution and Join Federation Execution service invocations.

attribute.name: HLAtimeImplementationName
attribute.semantics: Name of the time implementation as supplied to the Create Federation Execution service when the federation was created.

attribute.name: HLAlastSaveName
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever Federation Saved service is successfully invoked with a save-success indicator of successful
attribute.semantics: Name associated with the last federation state save (null if no saves have occurred)

attribute.name: HLAlastSaveTime
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever Federation Saved service is successfully invoked with a save-success indicator of successful
attribute.semantics: Logical time at which the last federation state save occurred. If the last save was not a timed save, then the HLAlastSaveTime attribute value shall be an empty (zero-length) HLAlogicalTime array to indicate that the value of the HLAlastSaveTime attribute is undefined. If no timed saves have occurred the value shall be an empty (zero-length) HLAlogicalTime array.

attribute.name: HLAnextSaveName
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever Request Federation Save service is successfully invoked
attribute.semantics: Name associated with the next federation state save (null if no saves are scheduled)

attribute.name: HLAnextSaveTime
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever Request Federation Save service is successfully invoked
attribute.semantics: Logical time at which the next federation state timed save is scheduled. If no timed saves are scheduled the value shall be an empty (zero-length) HLAlogicalTime array.

attribute.name: HLAautoProvide
attribute.updateCondition: Whenever the HLAmanager.HLAfederate.HLAfederation.HLAadjust.HLAsetSwitches interaction is sent to successfully change the value of the HLAautoProvide parameter.
attribute.semantics: Value of federation-wide Auto-Provide Switch. Updated when value of switch changes

objectClass.name: BaseEntity
objectClass.semantics: A base class of aggregate and discrete scenario domain participants. The BaseEntity class is characterized by being located at a particular location in space and independently movable, if capable of movement at all. It specifically excludes elements normally considered to be a component of another element. The BaseEntity class is intended to be a container for common attributes for entities of this type. Since it lacks sufficient class specific attributes that are required for simulation purposes, federates cannot publish objects of this class. Certain simulation management federates, e.g. viewers, may subscribe to this class. Simulation federates will normally subscribe to one of the subclasses, to gain the extra information required to properly simulate the entity.

attribute.name: EntityType
attribute.semantics: The category of the entity.

attribute.name: EntityIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The unique identifier for the entity instance.

attribute.name: IsPartOf
attribute.semantics: Defines if the entity if a constituent part of another entity (denoted the host entity). If the entity is a constituent part of another entity then the HostEntityIdentifier shall be set to the EntityIdentifier of the host entity and the HostRTIObjectIdentifier shall be set to the RTI object instance ID of the host entity. If the entity is not a constituent part of another entity then the HostEntityIdentifier shall be set to 0.0.0 and the HostRTIObjectIdentifier shall be set to the empty string.

attribute.name: Spatial
attribute.semantics: Spatial state stored in one variant record attribute.

attribute.name: RelativeSpatial
attribute.semantics: Relative spatial state stored in one variant record attribute.

objectClass.name: AggregateEntity
objectClass.semantics: A group of one or more separate objects that operate together as part of an organization. These objects may be discrete, may be other aggregate objects, or may be a mixture of both.

attribute.name: AggregateMarking
attribute.semantics: A unique marking or combination of characters used to distinguish the aggregate from other aggregates.

attribute.name: AggregateState
attribute.semantics: An indicator of the extent of association of objects form an operating group.

attribute.name: Dimensions
attribute.semantics: The size of the area covered by the units in the aggregate.

attribute.name: EntityIdentifiers
attribute.semantics: The identification of entities that are contained within the aggregate.

attribute.name: ForceIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The identification of the force that the aggregate belongs to.

attribute.name: Formation
attribute.semantics: The category of positional arrangement of the entities within the aggregate.

attribute.name: NumberOfSilentEntities
attribute.semantics: The number of elements in the SilentEntities list.

attribute.name: NumberOfVariableDatums
attribute.semantics: The number of records in the VariableDatums structure.

attribute.name: SilentAggregates
attribute.semantics: The numbers and types, of silent aggregates contained in the aggregate. Silent aggregates are sub-aggregates that are in the aggregate, but that are not separately represented in the virtual world.

attribute.name: SilentEntities
attribute.semantics: The numbers and types, of silent entities in the aggregate. Silent entities are entities that are in the aggregate, but that are not separately represented in the virtual world.

attribute.name: SubAggregateIdentifiers
attribute.semantics: The identifications of aggregates represented in the virtual world that are contained in the aggregate.

attribute.name: VariableDatums
attribute.semantics: Extra data that describes the aggregate.

objectClass.name: NETN_Aggregate
objectClass.semantics: Aggregate extensions for NETN

attribute.name: UniqueId
attribute.semantics: Required. A unique identifier for the object. The Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) is either generated or defined as part of scenario initialization, e.g. using NETN-ORG MSDL data. The unique identifier can serve dual purposes. It is a unique identification of the NETN_Aggregate object instance but can also be a reference to a NETN-ORG unit element with the same unique identifier.

attribute.name: Status
attribute.semantics: Required. Indicate if this aggregate unit currently is being simulated or not. E.g. units mounted or embarked on transports can be set to inactive. During an inactive state, the attribute values may not reflect an accurate, current value. Therefore, any subscribing federate can ignore inactive units. An inactive instance may have its instance attributes updated by a federate but reflected updates shall be ignored by receiving federates. All attributes must be updated to represent the current status of the instance before setting the status to active.

attribute.name: SubunitList
attribute.semantics: Optional. Reference to disaggregated representations of subsets of the aggregate unit when registered in the federation. Each element should refer to an existing NETN_Aggregate object in the federation. If not published, disaggregation is not supported.

attribute.name: ParentUnit
attribute.semantics: Optional. Reference to parent aggregate entity. If not published, aggregation is not supported. The default value is 0000000000000000 (no parent unit).

attribute.name: DividedUnitList
attribute.semantics: Optional. Reference to other aggregate or physical entities divided from the aggregate unit to represent specific subsets of holdings. If not published, a division is not supported.

attribute.name: SourceUnit
attribute.semantics: Optional. Reference to an active NETN_Aggregate instance, the source of a NETN-MRM division. If not published, merging is not supported. The default value is 0000000000000000 representing no source unit.

attribute.name: EmbeddedUnitList
attribute.semantics: Optional. Reference to units or platforms embarked on and transported by this unit. If not published, transport of embedded units not supported.

attribute.name: HigherHeadquarters
attribute.semantics: Optional. A reference to an entity representing the aggregate unit's superior or headquarters from which orders are given and to which reports are sent. The highest level unit or headquarters will publish 0000000000000000 as its HigherHeadquarters value. The referenced entity may or may not be registered in the federation as a NETN_Aggregate and/or NETN-ORG unit. If not published, the aggregate does not have a superior unit or headquarter. The default value is 0000000000000000 (no higher headquarters).

attribute.name: Mounted
attribute.semantics: Optional. The percentage of aggregate personnel travelling on or in their organic transport. Default 100% - all personnel mounted.

attribute.name: SymbolId
attribute.semantics: Optional. A symbol identifier represented as a string.

attribute.name: Callsign
attribute.semantics: Required. A callsign used to address the unit. Callsigns should be unique in the context in which they are used but not required to be globally unique.

attribute.name: Echelon
attribute.semantics: Optional. The size of the unit (level of command).

attribute.name: EntityList
attribute.semantics: Optional. This attribute provides data on all entities comprising the aggregate. Entities include equipment, e.g. platforms, weapons, sensors and lifeforms such as personnel. Each entity contains key status attributes and subunit allocation information. If not provided the status and allocation of entities is not modelled on an entity level.

attribute.name: SuppliesStatus
attribute.semantics: Optional. The type and quantities of supplies available (on hand) to the unit. If not provided, the amount of available supplies is undefined.

attribute.name: EquipmentStatus
attribute.semantics: Optional. This summarizes the health status of the equipment comprising the aggregate. If not provided, the status of equipment is undefined.

attribute.name: PersonnelStatus
attribute.semantics: Optional. This summarizes the health status of personnel comprising the aggregate. If not provided, the status of personnel is undefined.

attribute.name: VisualSignature
attribute.semantics: Describes the unit's susceptibility to electro-optical detection.

attribute.name: HUMINTSignature
attribute.semantics: Describes the unit's susceptibility to human intelligence (HUMINT), i.e. information collected and provided by human sources.

attribute.name: ElectronicSignature
attribute.semantics: Describes the aggregate's susceptibility to electronic detection both as a summary value and by identifying aggregate sensors together with their operational status.

attribute.name: CombatValue
attribute.semantics: Optional. A summary value (in per cent) of unit effectiveness based on the level of training, leadership, morale, personnel and equipment operational status, etc. The default value is 100%.

attribute.name: CoverStatus
attribute.semantics: Optional. Describes the unit's protection from the effects of weapons fire. Default is 0% - Fully affected by weapon fire.

attribute.name: CaptureStatus
attribute.semantics: The status of an aggregate with respect to its control or influence over its own activities.

attribute.name: Mission
attribute.semantics: The operational task the aggregate has been ordered to perform.

attribute.name: Activity
attribute.semantics: Optional. The current activity of the platform. The value is based on the Joint Consultation, Command and Control Information Exchange Data Model (JC3IEDM) action-event-category-code. The JC3IEDM is a fully documented standard [NATO STANAG 5525] for an information exchange data model for the sharing of C2 information. Default is 0 (Other activity).

attribute.name: Route
attribute.semantics: Optional. The current path of movement.

attribute.name: Destination
attribute.semantics: Optional. The current destination of movement.

attribute.name: WeaponsControlOrder
attribute.semantics: Optional. Describes current Weapon Control Order Free, Tight, or Hold. Default is 0 - Other.

attribute.name: Posture
attribute.semantics: Optional. Informations about an unit's posture.

attribute.name: IsPC
attribute.semantics: Optional. Informations about an Poste de commandemant.

objectClass.name: PhysicalEntity
objectClass.semantics: A base class of all discrete platform scenario domain participants.

attribute.name: AcousticSignatureIndex
attribute.semantics: Index used to obtain the acoustics (sound through air) signature state of the entity.

attribute.name: AlternateEntityType
attribute.semantics: The category of entity to be used when viewed by entities on the 'opposite' side.

attribute.name: ArticulatedParametersArray
attribute.semantics: Identification of the visible parts, and their states, of the entity which are capable of independent motion.

attribute.name: CamouflageType
attribute.semantics: The type of camouflage in use (if any).

attribute.name: DamageState
attribute.semantics: The state of damage of the entity.

attribute.name: EngineSmokeOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's engine is generating smoke or not.

attribute.name: FirePowerDisabled
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's main weapon system has been disabled or not.

attribute.name: FlamesPresent
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity is on fire (with visible flames) or not.

attribute.name: ForceIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The identification of the force that the entity belongs to.

attribute.name: HasAmmunitionSupplyCap
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity has the capability to supply other entities with ammunition.

attribute.name: HasFuelSupplyCap
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity has the capability to supply other entities with fuel or not.

attribute.name: HasRecoveryCap
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity has the capability to recover other entities or not.

attribute.name: HasRepairCap
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity has the capability to repair other entities or not.

attribute.name: Immobilized
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity is immobilized or not.

attribute.name: InfraredSignatureIndex
attribute.semantics: Index used to obtain the infra-red signature state of the entity.

attribute.name: IsConcealed
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity is concealed or not.

attribute.name: LiveEntityMeasuredSpeed
attribute.semantics: The entity's own measurement of speed (e.g. air speed for aircraft).

attribute.name: Marking
attribute.semantics: A unique marking or combination of characters used to distinguish the entity from other entities.

attribute.name: PowerPlantOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's power plant is on or not.

attribute.name: PropulsionSystemsData
attribute.semantics: The basic operating data of the propulsion systems aboard the entity.

attribute.name: RadarCrossSectionSignatureIndex
attribute.semantics: Index used to obtain the radar cross section signature state of the entity.

attribute.name: SmokePlumePresent
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity is generating smoke or not (intentional or unintentional).

attribute.name: TentDeployed
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity has deployed tent or not.

attribute.name: TrailingEffectsCode
attribute.semantics: The type and size of any trail that the entity is making.

attribute.name: VectoringNozzleSystemData
attribute.semantics: The basic operational data for the vectoring nozzle systems aboard the entity.

objectClass.name: Platform
objectClass.semantics: A physical object under the control of armed forces upon which sensor, communication, or weapon systems may be mounted.

attribute.name: AfterburnerOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's afterburner is on or not.

attribute.name: AntiCollisionLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's anti-collision lights are on or not.

attribute.name: BlackOutBrakeLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's black out brake lights are on or not.

attribute.name: BlackOutLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's black out lights are on or not.

attribute.name: BrakeLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's brake lights are on or not.

attribute.name: FormationLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's formation lights are on or not.

attribute.name: HatchState
attribute.semantics: The state of the entity's (main) hatch.

attribute.name: HeadLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's headlights are on or not.

attribute.notes: RPRnotePhysical3 RPRnotePhysical10 RPRnotePhysical11 RPRnotePhysical12 RPRnotePhysical13 RPRnotePhysical15
attribute.name: InteriorLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's internal lights are on or not.

attribute.name: LandingLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's landing lights are on or not.

attribute.name: LauncherRaised
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's weapon launcher is in the raised position.

attribute.name: NavigationLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's navigation lights are on or not.

attribute.name: RampDeployed
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity has deployed a ramp or not.

attribute.name: RunningLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's running lights are on or not.

attribute.notes: RPRnotePhysical3 RPRnotePhysical10 RPRnotePhysical11 RPRnotePhysical12 RPRnotePhysical13 RPRnotePhysical15
attribute.name: SpotLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's spotlights are on or not.

attribute.name: TailLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the entity's tail lights are on or not.

objectClass.name: Aircraft
objectClass.semantics: A platform entity that operates mainly in the air, such as aircraft, balloons, etc. This includes the entities when they are on the ground.

objectClass.name: NETN_Aircraft
objectClass.semantics: Extension of RPR-FOM Aircraft object class.

attribute.name: UniqueId
attribute.semantics: Required. A unique identifier for the object. The Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) is either generated or defined as part of scenario initialization, e.g. using NETN-ORG MSDL data for defining specific platforms as equipment assigned to units.

attribute.name: Status
attribute.semantics: Required. Indicate if this platform currently is being simulated or not. E.g. platforms mounted or embarked on transports can be set to inactive. During an inactive state, the attribute values may not reflect an accurate, current value. Therefore, any subscribing federate can ignore inactive units. All attributes must be updated to represent the current status of the instance before setting the state to Active. An inactive instance may have its instance attributes updated by a federate but reflected updates shall be ignored by receiving federates. All attributes must be updated to represent the current status of the instance before status is set to active.

attribute.name: SourceUnit
attribute.semantics: Optional. Reference to an active NETN_Aggregate instance from which this physical entity was divided. If not published, merging is not supported. The default value is 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 (UUID with all zeros) representing no source unit.

attribute.name: EmbeddedUnitList
attribute.semantics: Optional. Reference to platforms or lifeforms embarked on this platform. If not published, transport of embedded units is not supported. Entities are referenced by UUID. E.g. when soldiers are transported in a NETN Physical entity, then references (UUIDs) to these soldier instances are added to the EmbeddedUnitList for the entity. When a soldier disembarks from the transporter, the reference (UUID) to that soldier is removed from the EmbeddedUnitList. The default value is an empty list.

attribute.name: Callsign
attribute.semantics: Required. A callsign used to address the platform. Callsigns should be unique in the context in which they are used but not required to be globally unique.

attribute.name: Activity
attribute.semantics: Optional. The current activity of the platform. The value is based on the Joint Consultation, Command and Control Information Exchange Data Model (JC3IEDM) action-event-category-code. The JC3IEDM is a fully documented standard [NATO STANAG 5525] for an information exchange data model for the sharing of C2 information. The default value is 0 (Other activity).

attribute.name: Route
attribute.semantics: Optional. The current path of movement.

attribute.name: Destination
attribute.semantics: Optional. The current destination of movement.

attribute.name: SymbolId
attribute.semantics: Optional. A symbol identifier represented as a string.

objectClass.name: CBRN_Aircraft

objectClass.semantics: Extensions for NETN

attribute.name: UniqueId
attribute.semantics: Required. A unique identifier for the object. The Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) is either generated or defined as part of scenario initialization, e.g. using NETN-ORG MSDL data for defining specific platforms as equipment assigned to units.

attribute.name: Status
attribute.semantics: Required. Indicate if this platform currently is being simulated or not. E.g. platforms mounted or embarked on transports can be set to inactive. During an inactive state, the attribute values may not reflect an accurate, current value. Therefore, any subscribing federate can ignore inactive units. All attributes must be updated to represent the current status of the instance before setting the state to Active. An inactive instance may have its instance attributes updated by a federate but reflected updates shall be ignored by receiving federates. All attributes must be updated to represent the current status of the instance before status is set to active.

attribute.name: SourceUnit
attribute.semantics: Optional. Reference to an active NETN_Aggregate instance from which this physical entity was divided. If not published, merging is not supported. The default value is 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 (UUID with all zeros) representing no source unit.

attribute.name: EmbeddedUnitList
attribute.semantics: Optional. Reference to platforms or lifeforms embarked on this platform. If not published, transport of embedded units is not supported. Entities are referenced by UUID. E.g. when soldiers are transported in a NETN Physical entity, then references (UUIDs) to these soldier instances are added to the EmbeddedUnitList for the entity. When a soldier disembarks from the transporter, the reference (UUID) to that soldier is removed from the EmbeddedUnitList. The default value is an empty list.

attribute.name: Callsign
attribute.semantics: Required. A callsign used to address the platform. Callsigns should be unique in the context in which they are used but not required to be globally unique.

attribute.name: Activity
attribute.semantics: Optional. The current activity of the platform. The value is based on the Joint Consultation, Command and Control Information Exchange Data Model (JC3IEDM) action-event-category-code. The JC3IEDM is a fully documented standard [NATO STANAG 5525] for an information exchange data model for the sharing of C2 information. The default value is 0 (Other activity).

attribute.name: Route
attribute.semantics: Optional. The current path of movement.

attribute.semantics: Optional. The current destination of movement.

objectClass.semantics: Countermeasures devices that are dispensed from another entity. The devices may be active emitters or passive reflectors of energy.

objectClass.name: Radio
objectClass.semantics: Electronic devices for the communication of both audio and data, operated by entities belonging to armed forces.

objectClass.name: Sensor
objectClass.semantics: Sensors and emitters, such as stand-alone radars, jammers, and detection systems, that are not part of another platform or system described by another Physical Entity, and are operated by armed forces.

attribute.name: AntennaRaised
attribute.semantics: Whether the sensor/emitter's antenna is raised or not.

attribute.name: BlackoutLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the sensor/emitter's blackout lights are on or not.

attribute.name: LightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the sensor/emitter's lights are on or not.

attribute.name: InteriorLightsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the sensor/emitter's interior lights are on or not.

attribute.name: MissionKill
attribute.semantics: Whether the sensor/emitter has sustained damage that will prevent it carrying out its mission or not (e.g. damaged antenna).

objectClass.name: CBRN_Detector
objectClass.semantics: Represents a CBRN detector. This object is used to pass information to a CBRN federate, which will model the detector internally and publish a CBRN_DetectorAlarm.

attribute.name: UniqueID
attribute.semantics: Unique representation of the detector’s ID.

attribute.name: ProcessingTime
attribute.semantics: Duration (in seconds) between the detector being exposed to a concentration of agent above its threshold and the detector raising an alarm.

attribute.name: AveragingTime
attribute.semantics: Duration (in seconds) over which the detector will collect samples.

attribute.name: DetectableAgents
attribute.semantics: Array of detectable agents and their thresholds.

attribute.name: Alarm
attribute.semantics: Data representing the alarm of this detector. Defaults to no alarm if the attribute is not set.

objectClass.name: CBRN_Sensor
objectClass.semantics: Represents a CBRN sensor. This object is used to pass information to a CBRN federate, which will return sensor readings by publishing CBRN_SensorUpdate interactions.

attribute.name: UniqueID
attribute.semantics: Unique representation of the sensor’s ID.

attribute.name: UpdateFrequency
attribute.semantics: Duration (in seconds) that this sensor would like between updated readings.

attribute.name: AveragingTime
attribute.semantics: Duration (in seconds) over which the sensor will collect samples.

attribute.name: DetectableAgents
attribute.semantics: Array of agents that this sensor wishes to detect.

attribute.name: SensorReadings
attribute.semantics: Latest sensor readings. Defaults to no readings if this attribute is not set.

objectClass.name: Supplies
objectClass.semantics: Supplies other than munitions, such as fuel, food and personnel.

objectClass.name: EnvironmentalEntity
objectClass.semantics: An object which has physical extent but not necessarily fixed size and shape, such as meteorological effects such as clouds or smokes.

attribute.name: OpacityCode
attribute.semantics: Specifies the density of an environmental entity

objectClass.name: EmbeddedSystem
objectClass.semantics: A base class used to associate components such as sensor and emitting systems with their parent entity object.

attribute.name: EntityIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The EntityIdentifier of the object which this embedded system is a part of.

attribute.name: HostObjectIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The RTI object instance ID of the object of which this embedded system is part of.

attribute.name: RelativePosition
attribute.semantics: The position of the embedded system, relative to the host object's position.

objectClass.name: RadioTransmitter
objectClass.semantics: A device that sends out information encoded in electromagnetic waves in the radio frequency range.

attribute.name: AntennaPatternData
attribute.semantics: The radiation pattern of the radio's antenna.

attribute.name: CryptographicMode
attribute.semantics: The mode of the cryptographic system.

attribute.name: CryptoSystem
attribute.semantics: The type of cryptographic equipment in use.

attribute.name: EncryptionKeyIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The identification of the key used to encrypt the radio signals being transmitted. The transmitter and receiver should be considered to be using the same key if these numbers match.

attribute.name: Frequency
attribute.semantics: The center frequency of the radio transmissions.

attribute.name: FrequencyBandwidth
attribute.semantics: The bandpass of the radio transmissions.

attribute.name: RadioIndex
attribute.semantics: A number that uniquely identifies this radio from others on the host.

attribute.name: RadioInputSource
attribute.semantics: Specifies which position or data port provided the input for the transmission.

attribute.name: RadioSystemType
attribute.semantics: The type of radio transmitter.

attribute.name: RFModulationSystemType
attribute.semantics: The radio system type associated with this transmitter.

attribute.name: RFModulationType
attribute.semantics: Classification of the modulation type.

attribute.name: SpreadSpectrum
attribute.semantics: Describes the spread spectrum characteristics of the transmission, such as frequency hopping or other spread spectrum transmission modes.

attribute.name: StreamTag
attribute.semantics: A globally unique identifier for the associated audio stream

attribute.name: TimeHopInUse
attribute.semantics: Whether the radio is using time hopping or not.

attribute.name: TransmittedPower
attribute.semantics: The average transmitted power.

attribute.name: TransmitterOperationalStatus
attribute.semantics: The current operational state of the radio transmitter.

attribute.name: WorldLocation
attribute.semantics: The location of the antenna in the world coordinate system.

objectClass.name: RadioReceiver
objectClass.semantics: A device that converts incoming electromagnetic waves in the radio frequency range into information.

attribute.name: RadioIndex
attribute.semantics: A number that uniquely identifies this radio receiver from other receivers on the host object.

attribute.name: ReceivedPower
attribute.semantics: The radio frequency power received, after applying any propagation loss and antenna gain.

attribute.name: ReceivedTransmitterIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The object instance ID of the transmitter that generated the received radio signal.

attribute.name: ReceiverOperationalStatus
attribute.semantics: The operational state of the radio receiver.

objectClass.name: Designator
objectClass.semantics: A system used to designate or mark a location or object, such as a laser designator which supports a laser-guided weapon engagement.

attribute.name: CodeName
attribute.semantics: The code name of the designator system.

attribute.name: DesignatedObjectIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The object instance ID of the entity that is currently being designated (if any).

attribute.name: DesignatorCode
attribute.semantics: The designator code being used by the designating entity.

attribute.name: DesignatorEmissionWavelength
attribute.semantics: The wavelength of the designator system.

attribute.name: DesignatorOutputPower
attribute.semantics: The output power of the designator system.

attribute.name: DesignatorSpotLocation
attribute.semantics: The location, in the world coordinate system, of the designator spot.

attribute.name: DeadReckoningAlgorithm
attribute.semantics: Dead reckoning algorithm used by the issuing object.

attribute.name: RelativeSpotLocation
attribute.semantics: The location of the designator spot, relative to the object being designated (if any).

attribute.name: SpotLinearAccelerationVector
attribute.semantics: The rate of change in linear velocity of the designator spot over time.

objectClass.name: EmitterSystem
objectClass.semantics: A device that radiates an electromagnetic signal, such as a radar or jammer.

attribute.name: EmitterFunctionCode
attribute.semantics: The function of the emitter system.

attribute.name: EmitterType
attribute.semantics: The type of the emitter system.

attribute.name: EmitterIndex
attribute.semantics: A unique number, which uniquely identifies the emitter system from other on the same host entity.

attribute.name: EventIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The EventIdentifier is used by the generating federate to associate related events. The event number shall start at one at the beginning of the exercise, and be incremented by one for each event.

objectClass.name: IFF
objectClass.semantics: Interrogator Friend or Foe (IFF) system, Air Traffic Control Beacon and Transponder system, collision avoidance and navigational aids systems.

attribute.name: BeamAzimuthCenter
attribute.semantics: The azimuth center of the IFF beam's scan volume relative to the IFF system.

attribute.name: BeamAzimuthSweep
attribute.semantics: The azimuth half-angle of the IFF beam's scan volume relative to the IFF system.

attribute.name: BeamElevationCenter
attribute.semantics: The elevation center of the IFF beam's scan volume relative to the IFF system.

attribute.name: BeamElevationSweep
attribute.semantics: The elevation half-angle of the IFF beam's scan volume relative to the IFF system.

attribute.name: BeamSweepSync
attribute.semantics: The percentage of time a scan is through its pattern from its origin.

attribute.name: EventIdentifier
attribute.semantics: Used to associate related events.

attribute.name: FundamentalParameterData
attribute.semantics: The fundamental energy radiation characteristics of the IFF/ATC/NAVAIDS system.

attribute.name: Layer2DataAvailable
attribute.semantics: Specifies if level 2 data is available for this IFF system. If level 2 data is available then the BeamAzimuthCenter, BeamAzimuthSweep, BeamElevationCenter, BeamElevationSweep, BeamSweepSync, FundamentalParameterData, SecondaryOperationalDataParameter1, and SecondaryOperationalDataParameter2 attributes shall be generated.

attribute.name: SecondaryOperationalDataParameter1
attribute.semantics: Additional characteristics of the IFF/ATC/NAVAIDS emitting system.

attribute.name: SecondaryOperationalDataParameter2
attribute.semantics: Additional characteristics of the IFF/ATC/NAVAIDS emitting system.

attribute.name: SystemMode
attribute.semantics: Mode of operation.

attribute.name: SystemName
attribute.semantics: Particular named type of the IFF system in use.

attribute.name: SystemType
attribute.semantics: General type of IFF system in use.

attribute.name: SystemIsOn
attribute.semantics: Whether or not the system is on.

attribute.name: SystemIsOperational
attribute.semantics: Whether or not the system is operational.

objectClass.name: NatoIFF
objectClass.semantics: NATO Identification Friend or Foe (IFF) system that uses electromagnetic transmissions to which friendly forces' equipment automatically responds.

attribute.name: AlternateMode4
attribute.semantics: IFF Alternate Mode 4.

attribute.name: Mode1IsDamaged

attribute.name: Mode1IsOn

attribute.name: Mode5CEnabled

attribute.name: Mode5CIsDamaged

attribute.name: Mode5CIsOn

attribute.name: ModeSEnabled

attribute.name: ModeSIsDamaged
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not Parameter 6 - Mode S is damaged.

attribute.name: ModeSIsMalfunctioning

attribute.name: ModeSIsOn
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not Parameter 6 - Mode S is on.

attribute.name: ModeSIsTcasI
attribute.semantics: Specifies which Traffic Alert/Collision Avoidance System is used. FALSE means TCAS I, TRUE means TCAS II.

objectClass.name: NatoIFFInterrogator
objectClass.semantics: The part of an IFF system that first transmits electromagnetic signals.

objectClass.name: NatoIFFTransponder
objectClass.semantics: The part of a specific IFF system that responds (for example by emitting pulses) to the electromagnetic signals.

attribute.name: EmergencyOn
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not emergency is on.

attribute.name: IdentSquawkFlashOn
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the squawk ident/flash is on.

attribute.name: Mode1Code
attribute.semantics: Mode 1 code, two octal values.

attribute.name: Mode2Code
attribute.semantics: Mode 2 code, four octal values.

attribute.name: Mode3ACode
attribute.semantics: Mode 3 code, four octal values.

attribute.name: Mode5CAltitude

attribute.name: Mode5CAltitudeAvailable
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not Parameter 5 - Mode C altitude is available.

attribute.name: StiOn
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not STI is on.

objectClass.name: SovietIFFInterrogator
objectClass.semantics: Soviet IFF Interrogator

objectClass.name: SovietIFFTransponder
objectClass.semantics: Soviet IFF Transponder

objectClass.name: RRB
objectClass.semantics: RRB IFF transponder system

attribute.name: Code
attribute.semantics: RRB Code (range 0-16)

attribute.name: PowerReduction
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not power reduction is on.

attribute.name: IsDamaged
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the system is damaged.

attribute.name: IsMalfunctioning
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the system is malfunctioning.

attribute.name: IsOn
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the system is on.

attribute.name: RadarEnhancement
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the radar enhancement is on.

objectClass.name: MinefieldData
objectClass.semantics: The MinefieldData object class provides data about collections of mines within a minefield on an individual mine basis.

attribute.name: GroundBurialDepthOffset
attribute.semantics: Specifies the offset of the origin of the mine coordinate system with respect to the ground surface

attribute.name: Fusing
attribute.semantics: Specifies the primary and secondary fuse and anti-handling device for each mine in a collection of mines

attribute.name: MineEmplacementTime
attribute.semantics: Specifies the real-world (UTC) emplacement time of each mine in a collection of mines

attribute.name: MineEntityIdentifier
attribute.semantics: Identifies the mine entity identifier; the MineEntityID in conjunction with the MinefieldID form the unique identifier for each mine

attribute.name: MinefieldIdentifier
attribute.semantics: Identifies the minefield to which the mines belong

attribute.name: MineLocation
attribute.semantics: Specifies the location of the mine relative to the minefield location for each mine in a collection of mines

attribute.name: MineOrientation
attribute.semantics: Specifies the orientation of the center axis direction of fire of the mine, relative to the minefield Coordinate System for each mine in a collection of mines

attribute.name: MineType
attribute.semantics: Specifies the type of mine for the collection of mines contained within the MinefieldData object

attribute.name: NumberTripDetonationWires
attribute.semantics: Specifies the number of trip detonation wires that exist for each mine in a collection of mines

attribute.name: NumberWireVertices
attribute.semantics: Specifies the number of vertices for each trip wire of each mine in a collection of mines

attribute.name: PaintScheme
attribute.semantics: Specifies the camouflage scheme/color of the mine

attribute.name: Reflectance
attribute.semantics: Specifies the local dielectric difference between the mine and the surrounding soil

attribute.name: ScalarDetectionCoefficient
attribute.semantics: Specifies the coefficient to be utilized to insure proper correlation between detectors located on different simulation platforms

attribute.name: SensorTypes
attribute.semantics: In QRP mode, specifies the requesting sensor types which were specified in the minefield query whereas in Heartbeat mode, specifies the sensor types that are being served by the minefield

attribute.name: SnowBurialDepthOffset
attribute.semantics: Specifies the offset of the origin of the mine coordinate system with respect to the snow surface

attribute.name: ThermalContrast
attribute.semantics: Specifies the temperature difference between the mine and the surround soil in degrees Centigrade

attribute.name: WaterBurialDepthOffset
attribute.semantics: Specifies the offset of the origin of the mine coordinate system with respect to the water surface

attribute.name: WireVertices
attribute.semantics: Specifies the locations of vertices in a trip wire

objectClass.name: UnderwaterAcousticsEmission
objectClass.semantics: The underwater acoustic classes used to communicate underwater acoustic active, intentional emissions and Passive Signature or Unintentional Emissions information. These emissions are used during undersea warfare scenarios to detect, classify, and track hostile forces when electronic warfare mechanisms are unavailable.

attribute.name: EventIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The generating federate uses the Event Identifier to associate related events. The event number begins at one at the beginning of the exercise and is incremented by one for each event.

objectClass.name: ActiveSonar
objectClass.semantics: Describes the state of an active sonar system.

attribute.name: AcousticName
attribute.semantics: Defines the type of sonar being represented.

attribute.name: FunctionCode
attribute.semantics: Declares the current primary use of the sonar. It may be used by simulatons to infer intent.

attribute.name: AcousticsIdentifier
attribute.semantics: Unique identifier for the sonar on an entity, Starts with 1

objectClass.name: PropulsionNoise
objectClass.semantics: Describes the steady state component of unintended passive emissions that are normally associated with the power plant

attribute.name: HullMaskerOn
attribute.semantics: Whether the hull masker silencing system is on.

attribute.name: PassiveParameterIndex
attribute.semantics: Database index to look up the entities acoustic signature

attribute.name: PropulsionPlantConfiguration
attribute.semantics: The operating mode of the propulsion plant

attribute.name: ShaftRateData
attribute.semantics: Information about each of the propulsion shafts associated with the entity. Shafts are ordered from port to starboard, when looking from the stern to the bow.

objectClass.name: AdditionalPassiveActivities
objectClass.semantics: Describes the steady state components of non-propulsion passive emissions such as those held in the Additional Narrowband Database (ANDB).

attribute.name: ActivityCode
attribute.semantics: Database index used to indicate the passive signature of the entity

attribute.name: ActivityParameter
attribute.semantics: The current state of this activity.

attribute.name: IsSilent
attribute.semantics: Used to silence an additional passive activity without destroying this object.

objectClass.name: EmitterBeam
objectClass.semantics: A sector of concentrated energy from a device that radiates an electromagnetic signal. See also IEEE 1278.1-1995 Section 5.4.7.1.

attribute.name: BeamAzimuthCenter
attribute.semantics: The azimuth center of the emitter beam's scan volume relative to the emitter system.

attribute.name: BeamAzimuthSweep
attribute.semantics: The azimuth half-angle of the emitter beam's scan volume relative to the emitter system.

attribute.name: BeamElevationCenter
attribute.semantics: The elevation center of the emitter beam's scan volume relative to the emitter system.

attribute.name: BeamElevationSweep
attribute.semantics: The elevation half-angle of the emitter beam's scan volume relative to the emitter system.

attribute.name: BeamFunctionCode
attribute.semantics: The function of the emitter beam.

attribute.name: BeamIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The identification of the emitter beam (must be unique on the emitter system).

attribute.name: BeamParameterIndex
attribute.semantics: The index, into the federation specific emissions database, of the current operating mode of the emitter beam.

attribute.name: EffectiveRadiatedPower
attribute.semantics: The effective radiated power of the emitter beam.

attribute.name: EmissionFrequency
attribute.semantics: The center frequency of the emitter beam.

attribute.name: EmitterSystemIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The identification of the emitter system that is generating this emitter beam.

attribute.name: EventIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The EventIdentifier is used by the generating federate to associate related events. The event number shall start at one at the beginning of the exercise, and be incremented by one for each event.

attribute.name: FrequencyRange
attribute.semantics: The bandwidth of the frequencies covered by the emitter beam.

attribute.name: PulseRepetitionFrequency
attribute.semantics: The Pulse Repetition Frequency of the emitter beam.

attribute.name: PulseWidth
attribute.semantics: The pulse width of the emitter beam.

attribute.name: SweepSynch
attribute.semantics: The percentage of time a scan is through its pattern from its origin.

objectClass.name: RadarBeam
objectClass.semantics: A sector of concentrated energy from a device that radiates an electromagnetic signal.

attribute.name: HighDensityTrack
attribute.semantics: When TRUE the receiving simulation can assume that all targets that are in the scan pattern of the radar beam are being tracked

attribute.name: TrackObjectIdentifiers
attribute.semantics: Identification of the entities being tracked.

objectClass.name: JammerBeam
objectClass.semantics: An emitter beam that is designed to jam or otherwise interfere or confuse another emitter system

attribute.name: JammingModeSequence
attribute.semantics: The jamming mode technique or series of techniques being applied.

attribute.name: JammedObjectIdentifiers
attribute.semantics: Identification of the emitter beams being jammed.

attribute.name: HighDensityJam
attribute.semantics: When TRUE the receiving simulation can assume that all emitter beams that are in the scan pattern of the jammer beam are being jammed

objectClass.name: Minefield
objectClass.semantics: An area of ground or water containing mines laid with or without a pattern.

attribute.name: Valorization
attribute.semantics: Optional. Object's valorization state

attribute.name: Bypass
attribute.semantics: Optional. Object's bypass state

attribute.name: ActiveStatus
attribute.semantics: Specifies the active status of the minefield

attribute.name: ForceIdentifier
attribute.semantics: Identifies the force to which the minefield belongs

attribute.name: Lane
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the minefield has an active lane

attribute.name: MinefieldAppearanceType
attribute.semantics: Specifies the appearance information needed for displaying the symbology of the minefield

attribute.name: MinefieldIdentifier
attribute.semantics: Uniquely identifies this minefield instance in association with the federate's site and application

attribute.name: MinefieldLocation
attribute.semantics: Specifies the location of the center of the minefield

attribute.name: MinefieldOrientation
attribute.semantics: Specifies the orientation of the minefield, with Euler angles

attribute.name: MinefieldType
attribute.semantics: Specifies the minefield type

attribute.name: MineTypes
attribute.semantics: Specifies the type of each mine contained within the minefield

attribute.name: PerimeterPointCoordinates
attribute.semantics: Specifies the location of each perimeter point, relative to the minefield location

attribute.name: ProtocolMode
attribute.semantics: Specifies the mode (Heartbeat or Query Response Protocol) being used to communicate data about the minefield

attribute.name: State
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the minefield has been deactivated

objectClass.name: EnvironmentObject
objectClass.semantics: A base class of environment point, linear, or areal object classes.

attribute.name: ActiveStatus
attribute.semantics: Specifies the active status of the object

attribute.name: Construction
attribute.semantics: Object's construction percentage

attribute.name: Bypass
attribute.semantics: Optional. Object's bypass state

attribute.name: Valorization
attribute.semantics: Optional. Object's valorization state

attribute.name: ObjectIdentifier
attribute.semantics: Identifies this EnvironmentObject instance (point, linear or areal)

attribute.name: ReferencedObjectIdentifier
attribute.semantics: Identifies the Synthetic Environment object instance to which this EnvironmentObject instance is associated

attribute.name: ForceIdentifier
attribute.semantics: Identifies the force that created or modified this EnvironmentObject instance

attribute.name: ObjectType
attribute.semantics: Identifies the type of this EnvironmentObject instance

objectClass.name: ArealObject
objectClass.semantics: A synthetic environment object that is geometrically anchored to the terrain with a set of three or more points, which comes to a closure.

attribute.name: PointsData
attribute.semantics: Specifies the physical location (a collection of points) of the object

attribute.name: PercentComplete
attribute.semantics: Specifies the percent completion of the object

attribute.name: DamagedAppearance
attribute.semantics: Specifies the damaged appearance of the object

attribute.name: ObjectPreDistributed
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the object was created before the start of the exercise

attribute.name: Deactivated
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the object has been deactivated (it has ceased to exist in the synthetic environment)

attribute.name: Smoking
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the object is smoking (creating a smoke plume)

attribute.name: Flaming
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the object is aflame

objectClass.name: MinefieldObject
objectClass.semantics: A mine, mine weapon, mine row, mine strip, mine lane, mine marker or minefield, defined as an areal environment object.

attribute.name: BreachedStatus
attribute.semantics: Specifies the breached appearance of the minefield object

attribute.name: MineCount
attribute.semantics: Specifies the number of mines in the minefield

objectClass.name: OtherArealObject
objectClass.semantics: Areal objects other than Minefield objects.

objectClass.name: LinearObject
objectClass.semantics: A synthetic environment object that has size and an orientation and is geometrically anchored to the terrain with one point.

objectClass.name: MinefieldLaneMarkerObject
objectClass.semantics: A minefield lane marker showing a cleared lane through a specific minefield, defined as a linear object.

attribute.name: SegmentRecords
attribute.semantics: Specifies a minefield lane marker showing a cleared lane through a minefield

objectClass.name: BreachableLinearObject
objectClass.semantics: A linear object that can be breached.

attribute.name: Trafficability
attribute.semantics: Optional. Object's traficability state

attribute.name: CrossingSite
attribute.semantics: Optional. Object's crossing site state

attribute.name: SegmentRecords
attribute.semantics: Specifies a breachable linear object

objectClass.name: BreachObject
objectClass.semantics: A breach linear object.

attribute.name: SegmentRecords
attribute.semantics: Specifies a breach linear object

objectClass.name: ExhaustSmokeObject
objectClass.semantics: An exhaust smoke linear object.

attribute.name: SegmentRecords
attribute.semantics: Specifies an exhaust smoke linear object

objectClass.name: OtherLinearObject
objectClass.semantics: Linear objects other than BreachableLinear, Breach, ExhaustSmoke, or MinefieldLaneMarker objects.

objectClass.name: PointObject
objectClass.semantics: A synthetic environment object that is geometrically anchored to the terrain with a single point.

attribute.name: Location
attribute.semantics: Specifies the location of the object based on x, y and z coordinates

attribute.name: Orientation
attribute.semantics: Specifies the angles of rotation around the coordinate axis between the object's attitude and the reference coordinate system axes ; these are calculated as the Tait-Bryan Euler angles, specifying the successive rotations needed to transform from the world coordinate system to the object coordinate system

attribute.name: PercentComplete
attribute.semantics: Specifies the percent completion of the object

attribute.name: DamagedAppearance
attribute.semantics: Specifies the damaged appearance of the object instance

attribute.name: ObjectPreDistributed
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the object was created before the start of the exercise

attribute.name: Deactivated
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the object has been deactivated (it has ceased to exist in the synthetic environment)

attribute.name: Smoking
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the object is smoking (creating a smoke plume)

attribute.name: Flaming
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether or not the object is aflame

objectClass.name: BreachablePointObject
objectClass.semantics: A point object that can be breached.

attribute.name: BreachedStatus
attribute.semantics: Specifies the breached appearance of the object

objectClass.name: BurstPointObject
objectClass.semantics: A burst point object.

attribute.name: PercentOpacity
attribute.semantics: Specifies the opacity of the smoke

attribute.name: CylinderSize
attribute.semantics: Specifies the radius of the cylinder approximating an individual smoke burst ; for multiple bursts, the center bottom of each cylinder is calculated based on the model used to represent the multiple bursts

attribute.name: CylinderHeight
attribute.semantics: Specifies the height of the cylinder approximating an individual smoke burst ; for multiple bursts, the center bottom of each cylinder is calculated based on the model used to represent the multiple bursts

attribute.name: NumberOfBursts
attribute.semantics: Specifies the number of bursts in the instance of tactical smoke

attribute.name: ChemicalContent
attribute.semantics: Specifies the chemical content of the smoke

objectClass.name: CraterObject
objectClass.semantics: A pit, depression, or cavity formed in the surface of the earth by an explosion. The depression's shape can range from saucer to conical, depending largely of the depth of burst.

attribute.name: CraterSize
attribute.semantics: Specifies the diameter of the crater, where the center of the crater is at the point object location

objectClass.name: OtherPointObject
objectClass.semantics: Point objects other than Breachable, Burst, Crater, RibbonBridge, or Structure objects.

objectClass.name: RibbonBridgeObject
objectClass.semantics: A ribbon bridge object.

attribute.name: NumberOfSegments
attribute.semantics: Specifies the number of segments composing the ribbon bridge

objectClass.name: StructureObject
objectClass.semantics: A building structure, building rubble, stationary bridge, AVLB object.

objectClass.name: EnvironmentProcess
objectClass.semantics: An object class used to communicate information about environmental processes and effects.

attribute.name: ProcessIdentifier
attribute.semantics: Identifies which process issued the environmental process update

attribute.name: Type
attribute.semantics: Identifies the environmental process type

attribute.name: ModelType
attribute.semantics: Identifies the model used for generating this environmental process update ; defined in 1278.1a as being exercise specific

attribute.name: EnvironmentProcessActive
attribute.semantics: Specifies the status of the environmental process (active or inactive)

attribute.name: SequenceNumber
attribute.semantics: Optional, used to support update sequencing ; if not used, set to EP_NO_SEQUENCE ; when used, set to zero for each exercise and incremented by one for each update sent

attribute.name: EnvironmentRecData
attribute.semantics: Specifies environment records

objectClass.name: GriddedData
objectClass.semantics: An object class used to depict global, spatially varying environmental effects.

attribute.name: GridIdentifier
attribute.semantics: Identifies the environmental simulation application

attribute.name: CoordinateSystem
attribute.semantics: Specifies the coordinate system used to locate the data grid

attribute.name: NumberOfGridAxes
attribute.semantics: Specifies the number of grid axes used to define the data grid (e.g. three grid axes for an x, y, z coordinate system)

attribute.name: ConstantGrid
attribute.semantics: Specifies whether the grid axes remain constant for the life of the data grid

attribute.name: EnvironmentType
attribute.semantics: Identifies the type of environmental entity being described

attribute.name: Orientation
attribute.semantics: Specifies the orientation of the data grid, with Euler angles

attribute.name: SampleTime
attribute.semantics: Specifies the valid time of the environmental data sample

attribute.name: TotalValues
attribute.semantics: Specifies the number of data values that make up this grid

attribute.name: VectorDimension
attribute.semantics: Specifies the number of data values at each grid point ; VectorDimension shall be one for scalar data, and shall be greater than one when multiple enumerated environmental data values are sent for each grid point (e.g. u, v, w wind components have VectorDimension = 3)

attribute.name: GridAxisInfo
attribute.semantics: Specifies information on grid axes

attribute.name: GridDataInfo
attribute.semantics: Specifies information on grid data representations

objectClass.name: ActiveSonarBeam
objectClass.semantics: A sector of concentrated acoustic energy from an active sonar device.

attribute.name: ActiveEmissionParameterIndex
attribute.semantics: An index into the database of active (intentional) underwater acoustics emissions.

attribute.name: ActiveSonarIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The RTI ID of the ActiveSonar emitting this beam

attribute.name: AzimuthBeamwidth
attribute.semantics: The horizontal width of the main beam (as opposed to any side lobes) measured from beam center to the 3 dB down point. Omni directional beams shall have a beam width of 0 radians.

attribute.name: AzimuthCenter
attribute.semantics: The center azimuthal bearing of the main beam (as opposed to side lobes) in relation to the own ship heading, clockwise positive. Omnidirection beams shall have an azimuthal center of 0 radians.

attribute.name: BeamIdentifier
attribute.semantics: The identification of the active sonar beam, which must be unique on the active sonar system.

attribute.name: ElevationBeamwidth
attribute.semantics: Vertical angle from beam center to 3db down point. O is omnidirectional

attribute.name: ElevationCenter
attribute.semantics: The angle of axis of the beam center to the horizontal plane. Positive upward.

attribute.name: EventIdentifier
attribute.semantics: Used to associate changes to the beam with its ActiveSonar.

attribute.name: ScanPattern
attribute.semantics: The pattern that describes the angular movement of the sonar beam during its sweep.

objectClass.name: ORG_Root
objectClass.semantics: Root object class for all NETN-ORG object classes. Includes unique identifier and unique name attributes inherited by all subclasses.

attribute.name: UniqueId
attribute.semantics: Required. Unique Identifier.

objectClass.name: EquipmentItem
objectClass.semantics: Representation of an equipment item based on attributes defined in the NETN-ORG extensions of MSDL.

attribute.name: Name
attribute.semantics: Required. A unique name of the equipment item.

attribute.name: HoldingUnit
attribute.semantics: Required. Identifies the lowest level unit in the ORBAT to which this equipment item belongs.

attribute.name: MountedOn
attribute.semantics: Optional. Reference to another equipment item on which this item is mounted or attached.

attribute.name: EntityType
attribute.semantics: Required. SISO-REF-010 code for entity type definitions. If unknown, use 0.0.0.0.0.0.0.

attribute.name: NatoStockNumber
attribute.semantics: Optional. NATO stock number code. 13 digits (0-9)

attribute.name: SymbolId
attribute.semantics: Required. A symbol identifier represented as a string.

attribute.name: SymbolAmplification
attribute.semantics: Optional. Text amplifications for the equipment's symbol. Static or very low update rate.

attribute.name: Disposition
attribute.semantics: Required. Detailed positional information on equipment item.

attribute.name: CommunicationNetworks
attribute.semantics: Optional. Set of Communication Networks that the equipment monitors and uses to communicate during a mission.

attribute.name: Resolution
attribute.semantics: Optional. Enumeration indicating the level of fidelity appropriate for instancing the equipment in the simulation. Default value: NOT_SPECIFIED.

objectClass.name: AisEquipmentItem
objectClass.semantics: This class defines additional attributes for AIS equipment. Depending on the kind of AIS equipment, further attributes are added in sub-classes.

attribute.name: MMSI
attribute.semantics: Optional. The MMSI number (Maritime Mobile Service Identity) of the AIS station. If the value is not provided then the subscribing federate that is responsible for the modelling of the AIS station shall generate a value. Note that the value of each individual AIS station must be unique across all AIS stations in the simulation. Recycling MMSI numbers is not adviced since some systems may retain dead tracks for some time.

attribute.name: TransmitterStatus
attribute.semantics: Optional. The initial status of the AIS Transmitter(s) of the AIS station. If the value is not provided then the value shall assumed to be ON.

attribute.name: RadioSystemType
attribute.semantics: Optional. The type of transmitter. If the value is not provided then the subscribing federate that is responsible for the modelling of the AIS station shall determine the type of transmitter.

objectClass.name: Vessel
objectClass.semantics: This class defines additional attributes for vessel equipment.

attribute.name: IMO
attribute.semantics: Optional. The International Maritime Organization (IMO) number to identify the vessel. If the value is not provided then the subscribing federate that is responsible for the modelling of the vessel shall generate a value.

objectClass.name: SARaircraft
objectClass.semantics: This class defines additional attributes for SAR aircraft equipment.

objectClass.name: Basestation
objectClass.semantics: This class defines additional attributes for basestation equipment.

objectClass.name: AidToNavigation
objectClass.semantics: This class defines additional attributes for aid to navigation (ATON) equipment.

objectClass.name: Unit
objectClass.semantics: Representation of an organizational unit based on attributes defined in the NETN-ORG extensions of MSDL.

attribute.name: Name
attribute.semantics: Required. A unique name of the unit.

attribute.name: SuperiorUnit
attribute.semantics: Required. Reference to the superior unit. If this unit has no superior unit (i.e. is the top-unit) then the value of this attribute shall be 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 (UUID with all zeros).

attribute.name: EmbarkedIn
attribute.semantics: Optional. A reference to a unit or equipment item which is carrying/transporting the unit. Default value is 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 (UUID with all zeros) indicating that the unit is not embarked in or mounted on any other unit or equipment.

attribute.name: Force
attribute.semantics: Optional. A reference to the Force that the unit belongs to. A missing value is interpreted as the force being unknown/undetermined.

attribute.name: Holdings
attribute.semantics: Optional. A set of holdings of the unit. Default is an empty list.

attribute.name: EntityType
attribute.semantics: Required. The entity type to use for representation of the unit as an aggregate entity. Entity types should be based on SISO-REF-010 and/or defined by federation agreements.

attribute.name: SymbolId
attribute.semantics: Required. A symbol identifier represented as a string.

attribute.name: SymbolAmplification
attribute.semantics: Optional. Text amplifications for the unit's symbol. Static or very low update rate.

attribute.name: Disposition
attribute.semantics: Required. Detailed positional information on unit.

attribute.name: Formation
attribute.semantics: Optional. Formation of this unit.

attribute.name: IsHq
attribute.semantics: Optional. Indicate whether the unit has a command function, e.g. if it is an HQ or not.

attribute.name: Echelon
attribute.semantics: Optional. Symbol modifier identifying the command level. Default NONE.

attribute.name: CommunicationNetworks
attribute.semantics: Optional. Set of Communication Networks that the unit monitors and uses to communicate during a mission.

objectClass.name: Installation
objectClass.semantics: Representation of an installation/facility based on attributes defined in the NETN-ORG extensions of MSDL.

attribute.name: Name
attribute.semantics: Required. A unique name of the installation.

attribute.name: Owner
attribute.semantics: Required. Reference to the force, unit or equipment item owning or hosting the installation.

attribute.name: EntityType
attribute.semantics: Required. SISO-REF-010 code for entity type definitions. If unknown, use 0.0.0.0.0.0.0.

attribute.name: SymbolId
attribute.semantics: Required. A symbol identifier represented as a string.

attribute.name: SymbolAmplification
attribute.semantics: Optional. Text amplifications for the installation's symbol. Static or very low update rate.

attribute.name: Location
attribute.semantics: Required. Geographic location of the installation.

objectClass.name: Force
objectClass.semantics: Representation of a specific force and its relationship with other forces. Units belonging to a force all have the same relationship with units belonging to another force. The relationships between forces can be asymmetrical, e.g. Force A can be hostile to B while B is neutral to A. The relation may change during a federation execution.

attribute.name: Name
attribute.semantics: Required. Name of the force/side.

attribute.name: Relations
attribute.semantics: Optional. Sequence of relations, force-relation. Default is an empty array.

objectClass.name: FederateApplication
objectClass.semantics: Representation of the allocation of initial modelling responsibility of units and equipment items to a federate application.

attribute.name: Name
attribute.semantics: Required. A unique name in the organization to group units and equipment items. This group name is used to determine the initial allocation of modelling responsibility of units and equipment items to a federate. The federation agreements should specify how this name is to be interpreted and how the allocation will be performed. A common agreement and practice are to use the federate name as group name, i.e. the units and equipment items are allocated to the federate with that name. Typically one application will be responsible for performing the allocation. Alternatives for the group name are for example: federate type name, a functional name.

attribute.name: Units
attribute.semantics: Optional. The units for which the federate has the responsibility of simulating. Default is an empty list.

attribute.name: EquipmentItems
attribute.semantics: Optional. The equipment for which the federate has the responsibility of simulating. Default is an empty list.

attribute.name: Installations
attribute.semantics: Optional. The installations for which the federate has the responsibility of simulating. Default is an empty list.

objectClass.name: ATP45HazardArea
objectClass.semantics: Represents the footprint generated by a CBRN warning and reporting simulation. This follows the NATO ATP-45 doctrine to generate a hazard area.

attribute.name: Time
