This message type is a receipt acknowledgement to senders of previous messages of Message Type 12.

interactionClass.name: AisMessage9
interactionClass.semantics: Message type 9: Standard SAR Aircraft Position Report. Tracking information for search-and-rescue aircraft.

parameter.name: Altitude
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Altitude.

parameter.name: SpeedOverGround
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Speed over ground.

parameter.name: Position
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). AIS (Lat,Lon) position.

parameter.name: CourseOverGround
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Course over ground.

parameter.name: UTCtime
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Time of the report.

interactionClass.name: AisMessage10
interactionClass.semantics:
Message Type 10: UTC/Date Inquiry.
Request for UTC/Date information from an AIS base station.

parameter.name: Destination
parameter.semantics: Required. Destination MMSI.

interactionClass.name: AisMessage12
interactionClass.semantics:
Type 12: Addressed Safety-Related Message.
This is a point-to-point text message. The payload is interpreted as six-bit text.

parameter.name: Destination
parameter.semantics: Required. Destination MMSI.

parameter.name: Message
parameter.semantics: Required. 1-156 chars of six-bit text.

interactionClass.name: AisMessage14
interactionClass.semantics:
Type 14: Safety-Related Broadcast Message.
This is a broadcast text message. The payload is interpreted as six-bit text.

parameter.name: Message
parameter.semantics: Required. 1-161 chars of six-bit text.

interactionClass.name: AisMessage17
interactionClass.semantics:
Message Type 17: DGNSS Broadcast Binary Message.
This message type is used to broadcast differential corrections for GPS.

parameter.name: Position
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Position data.

interactionClass.name: AisMessage18
interactionClass.semantics:
Message Type 18: Standard Class B CS Position Report.
A less detailed report than message types 1-3 for vessels using Class B transmitters. Omits navigational status and rate of turn.

parameter.name: SpeedOverGround
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Speed over ground.

parameter.name: Position
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). AIS (Lat,Lon) position.

parameter.name: CourseOverGround
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Course over ground.

parameter.name: TrueHeading
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). True heading.

parameter.name: UTCtime
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Time of the report.

interactionClass.name: AisMessage21
interactionClass.semantics:
Message Type 21: Aid-to-Navigation Report.
Identification and location message to be emitted by aids to navigation such as buoys and lighthouses.

parameter.name: AidType
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not specified). Type of aid.

parameter.name: Name
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: 34 six-bit @ charachters). Up to max 34 six-bit charachters for the name of the aid.

parameter.name: Position
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). AIS (Lat,Lon) position.

parameter.name: DimensionBow
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Distance from bow.

parameter.name: DimensionStern
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Distance from stern.

parameter.name: DimensionPort
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Distance from port.

parameter.name: DimensionStarboard
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Distance from starboard.

parameter.name: UTCtime
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Time of the report.

parameter.name: OffPositionFlag
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: false). Off-Position Indicator. The Off-Position Indicator is for floating Aids-to-Navigation only: false means on position; true means off position. Only valid if UTCsecond is available.

parameter.name: VirtualFlag
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: false). Virtual-aid flag. The Virtual Aid flag is interpreted as follows: false = real Aid to Navigation at indicated position; true = virtual Aid to Navigation simulated by nearby AIS station.

interactionClass.name: AisMessage27
interactionClass.semantics:
Message Type 27: Long Range AIS Broadcast message.
This message type is primarily intended for long-range detection of AIS Class A equipped vessels (typically by satellite). This message has a similar content to Messages 1, 2 and 3, but the total number of bits has been compressed to allow for increased propagation delays associated with long-range detection.

parameter.name: NavigationStatus
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not defined). Navigational status.

parameter.name: Position
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). AIS (Lat,Lon) position.

parameter.name: SpeedOverGround
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Speed over ground.

parameter.name: CourseOverGround
parameter.semantics: Optional (Default: not available). Course over ground.

interactionClass.name: RepairComplete
interactionClass.semantics: Notifies the requesting entity that the requested repair has been completed.

parameter.name: ReceivingObject
parameter.semantics: Object requesting repairs

parameter.name: RepairingObject
parameter.semantics: Object that is able to perform the requested repair

parameter.name: RepairType
parameter.semantics: Type of repair performed

interactionClass.name: RepairResponse
interactionClass.semantics: Acknowledges the notification of the completion of a repair.

parameter.name: ReceivingObject
parameter.semantics: Object requesting repairs

parameter.name: RepairingObject
parameter.semantics: Object that is able to perform the requested repair

parameter.name: RepairResultCode
parameter.semantics: Result of repair

interactionClass.name: ResupplyCancel
interactionClass.semantics: Communicates the canceling of a service function by either the receiving or the supplying entity.

parameter.name: ReceivingObject
parameter.semantics: Object that is receiving supplies

parameter.name: SupplyingObject
parameter.semantics: Object that has offered supplies

interactionClass.name: ResupplyOffer
interactionClass.semantics: Communicates the offer of supplies from a supplying entity to a receiving entity.

parameter.name: ReceivingObject
parameter.semantics: Object that the supplies are being offered to.

parameter.name: SupplyingObject
parameter.semantics: Object that is offering the supplies

parameter.name: SuppliesData
parameter.semantics: List of supplies that are offered.

interactionClass.name: ResupplyReceived
interactionClass.semantics: Acknowledge the receipt of supplies.

parameter.name: ReceivingObject
parameter.semantics: Object that is receiving the supplies

parameter.name: SupplyingObject
parameter.semantics: Object that is providing the supplies.

parameter.name: SuppliesData
parameter.semantics: List of supplies taken by receiving object.

interactionClass.name: ServiceRequest
interactionClass.semantics: A request for logistics support. The requesting entity issues the interaction to the supplying entity asking for repair or specific supplies.

parameter.name: RequestingObject
parameter.semantics: Object requesting service

parameter.name: ServicingObject
parameter.semantics: Object that is able to provide the requested service

parameter.name: ServiceType
parameter.semantics: Type of requested service

parameter.name: SuppliesData
parameter.semantics: For a service of resupply, the list of supplies to be exchanged. If the service requested is not resupply, then this parameter shall be omitted.

interactionClass.name: MinefieldData
interactionClass.semantics: Provides information on individual mines contained within a minefield

parameter.name: GroundBurialDepthOffset
parameter.semantics: Specifies the offset of the origin of the mine coordinate system with respect to the ground surface

parameter.name: Fusing
parameter.semantics: Specifies the primary and secondary fuse and anti-handling device for each mine

parameter.name: MineEmplacementTime
parameter.semantics: Specifies the real-world (UTC) emplacement time of the mine

parameter.name: MineEntityIdentifier
parameter.semantics: Identifies the mine entity identifier; the MineEntityID in conjunction with the MinefieldID form the unique identifier for each mine

parameter.name: MinefieldIdentifier
parameter.semantics: Identifies the minefield to which the mines belong

parameter.name: MineLocation
parameter.semantics: Specifies the location of the relative to the minefield location

parameter.name: MineOrientation
parameter.semantics: Specifies the orientation of the center axis direction of fire of the mine, relative to the minefield Coordinate System

parameter.name: MineType
parameter.semantics: Specifies the type of each mine contained within the minefield interaction

parameter.name: NumberOfRecords
parameter.semantics: Specifies the total number of minefield records being published in response to a Minefield Query interaction

parameter.name: NumberTripDetonationWires
parameter.semantics: Specifies the number of trip detonation wires that exist for each mine

parameter.name: NumberWireVertices
parameter.semantics: Specifies the number of vertices for each trip wire

parameter.name: PaintScheme
parameter.semantics: Specifies the camouflage scheme/color of the mine

parameter.name: RecordSequenceNumber
parameter.semantics: Specifies the number of the current record in a sequence of minefield records published in response to a Minefield Query interaction

parameter.name: Reflectance
parameter.semantics: Specifies the local dielectric difference between the mine and the surrounding soil

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: Identifies the matching response to a request for mine information from the minefield simulation made by means of a Minefield Query interaction

parameter.name: RequestingEntityIdentifier
parameter.semantics: Identifies the entity that requested the information from the minefield simulation in QRP (Query Response Protocol) mode

parameter.name: ScalarDetectionCoefficient
parameter.semantics: Specifies the coefficient to be utilized to insure proper correlation between detectors located on different simulation platforms

parameter.name: SensorTypes
parameter.semantics: In QRP mode, specifies the requesting sensor types which were specified in the minefield query whereas in Heartbeat mode, specifies the sensor types that are being served by the minefield

parameter.name: SnowBurialDepthOffset
parameter.semantics: Specifies the offset of the origin of the mine coordinate system with respect to the snow surface

parameter.name: ThermalContrast
parameter.semantics: Specifies the temperature difference between the mine and the surrounding soil in degrees Centigrade

parameter.name: WaterBurialDepthOffset
parameter.semantics: Specifies the offset of the origin of the mine coordinate system with respect to the water surface

parameter.name: WireVertices
parameter.semantics: Specifies the locations of vertices in a trip wire

interactionClass.name: MinefieldQuery
interactionClass.semantics: Provides the means by which a federate shall query a minefield simulation for information on the individual mines within the minefield operating in QRP mode.

parameter.name: MinefieldIdentifier
parameter.semantics: Identifies the minefield to which this query is addressed

parameter.name: PerimeterPoints
parameter.semantics: Specifies the location of each perimeter point in the requested area relative to the minefield location

parameter.name: QueryFusing
parameter.semantics: Specifies whether or not fusing is requested

parameter.name: QueryMineOrientation
parameter.semantics: Specifies whether or not orientation is requested

parameter.name: QueryGroundBurialDepthOffset
parameter.semantics: Specifies whether or not ground burial depth offset is requested

parameter.name: QueryMineEmplacementAge
parameter.semantics: Specifies whether or not emplacement age is requested

parameter.name: QueryPaintScheme
parameter.semantics: Specifies whether or not paint scheme is requested

parameter.name: QueryReflectance
parameter.semantics: Specifies whether or not reflectance is requested

parameter.name: QueryScalarDetectionCoefficient

parameter.name: PercentComplete

parameter.name: BreachedStatus

parameter.name: PercentOpacity
parameter.semantics: Specifies the opacity of the smoke

parameter.name: CylinderSize
parameter.semantics: Specifies the radius of the cylinder approximating an individual smoke burst ; for multiple bursts, the center bottom of each cylinder is calculated based on the model used to represent the multiple bursts

parameter.name: CylinderHeight
parameter.semantics: Specifies the height of the cylinder approximating an individual smoke burst ; for multiple bursts, the center bottom of each cylinder is calculated based on the model used to represent the multiple bursts

parameter.name: NumberOfBursts
parameter.semantics: Specifies the number of bursts in the instance of tactical smoke

parameter.name: ChemicalContent

interactionClass.name: CraterObjectTransaction

interactionClass.name: OtherPointObjectTransaction

interactionClass.name: RibbonBridgeObjectTransaction
interactionClass.semantics: An interaction sent to an environment manager to request the creation, modification, or deletion of instances of the RibbonBridgeObject class.

parameter.name: NumberOfSegments
parameter.semantics: Specifies the number of segments composing the ribbon bridge

interactionClass.name: StructureObjectTransaction
interactionClass.semantics: An interaction sent to an environment manager to request the creation, modification, or deletion of instances of the StructureObject class.

interactionClass.name: Collision
interactionClass.semantics: The act or instance of coming together with solid impact.

parameter.name: CollidingObjectIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The object instance ID of the object that the issuing object has collided with.

parameter.name: IssuingObjectMass
parameter.semantics: The mass of the issuing object.

parameter.name: IssuingObjectVelocityVector
parameter.semantics: The velocity vector of the issuing object at the moment of impact.

parameter.name: CollisionType
parameter.semantics: The type of collision.

parameter.name: CollisionLocation
parameter.semantics: The location of the collision relative to the object that the issuing object has collided with.

parameter.name: EventIdentifier
parameter.semantics: An ID assigned by the issuing object to associate related collision events.

parameter.name: IssuingObjectIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The object instance ID of the object that has detected the collision and issued the collision interaction.

interactionClass.name: CollisionElastic
interactionClass.semantics: The act or instance of coming together with solid impact in an elastic manner. An elastic collision allows a higher fidelity collision to be modeled, taking into account linear and rotational momentum transfer, variable elasticity, and momentum transfer that is dependent on surface orientation.

parameter.name: CoefficientOfRestitution
parameter.semantics: The degree that energy is conserved in a collision.

parameter.name: IntermediateResultXX
parameter.semantics: X-X Component of the positive semi-definite Collision Intermediate Result matrix.

parameter.name: IntermediateResultXY
parameter.semantics: X-Y Component of the positive semi-definite Collision Intermediate Result matrix.

parameter.name: IntermediateResultXZ
parameter.semantics: X-Z Component of the positive semi-definite Collision Intermediate Result matrix.

parameter.name: IntermediateResultYY
parameter.semantics: Y-Y Component of the positive semi-definite Collision Intermediate Result matrix.

parameter.name: IntermediateResultYZ
parameter.semantics: Y-Z Component of the positive semi-definite Collision Intermediate Result matrix.

parameter.name: IntermediateResultZZ
parameter.semantics: Z-Z Component of the positive semi-definite Collision Intermediate Result matrix.

parameter.name: UnitSurfaceNormal
parameter.semantics: The normal vector to the surface at the point of collision detection.

interactionClass.name: Acknowledge
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of a SIMAN PDU from a Simulation Manager federate and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the federate has implemented the request.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient of the interaction.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: This field matches this response with the specific StartResume, StopFreeze, CreateEntity or RemoveEntity interaction sent by the simulation manager.

parameter.name: AcknowledgeFlag
parameter.semantics: The type of interaction being acknowledged.

parameter.name: ResponseFlag
parameter.semantics: The type of response made to the interaction by the recipient.

interactionClass.name: AcknowledgeR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of a SIMAN PDU, with a specified acknowledgement protocol, from a Simulation Manager federate and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the federate has implemented the request.

interactionClass.name: ActionRequest
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction sent from a Simulation Manager federate to one or more federates to request that they perform a specified action.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient(s) of the interaction.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Request ID is a monotonically increasing integer identifier inserted by the Simulation Manager into all Simulation management interactions. It is used as a unique identifier to identify the latest in a series of competing requests and identifying acknowledgements.

parameter.name: ActionRequestCode
parameter.semantics: The action that the recipient(s) are requested to perform.

parameter.name: FixedDatums
parameter.semantics: Optional additional data items (types and values)

parameter.name: VariableDatumSet
parameter.semantics: Optional additional data items (types and values). These data items are not of fixed length.

interactionClass.name: ActionRequestR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction sent from a Simulation Manager federate to one or more federates to request that they perform a specified action. The Simulation Manager federate specifies the acknowledgement protocol to be used.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for a transaction

interactionClass.name: ActionResponse
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of an ActionResponse interaction from a Simulation Manager federate and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the federate has implemented the request.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient of the interaction.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: This field matches this response with the specific ActionRequest interaction sent by the simulation manager.

parameter.name: RequestStatus
parameter.semantics: The status of the request that the recipient has been asked to perform.

parameter.name: FixedDatums
parameter.semantics: Additional, fixed length data items (types and values).

parameter.name: VariableDatumSet
parameter.semantics: Additional, non fixed length, data items (types and values).

interactionClass.name: ActionResponseR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of an ActionResponseR interaction from a Simulation Manager federate and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the federate has implemented the request.

interactionClass.name: Comment
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction used to insert messages and information into a log stream and closely matches the structures used by the Data interaction class. This information is usually unsolicited in nature. The information contained within the Interaction should be used for commenting purposes only.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient(s) of the interaction.

parameter.name: VariableDatumSet
parameter.semantics: The set of data items (types and values) associated with the interaction.

interactionClass.name: CreateEntity
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager to request that an application creates an entity. See DIS 4.5.5.4.1 and DIS 5.3.6 for details.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The FederateIdentifier field identifies the federate that is responsible for creating the entity (if possible). The complete parameter defines the entity ID of the new entity (see also note [18]).

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Request ID is a monotonically increasing integer identifier inserted by the Simulation Manager into all Simulation management interactions. It is used as a unique identifier to identify the latest in a series of competing requests and identifying acknowledgements.

interactionClass.name: CreateEntityR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager to request that an application creates an entity, using a specified acknowledgement service. See DIS 4.5.11.3.1 and DIS 5.3.12.1 for details.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for a transaction

interactionClass.name: Data
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge either a) a DataQuery interaction (in which case the Data interaction contains the results of the query) or b) a SetData interaction (in which case the Data interaction contains the data that the federate was able to set).

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient of the interaction.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: This field matches this response with the specific SetData or DataQuery interaction sent by the simulation manager.

parameter.name: FixedDatums
parameter.semantics: The set of data items (types and values), of fixed length, that the recipient can return for this interaction.

parameter.name: VariableDatumSet
parameter.semantics: The set of data items (types and values), of variable length, that the recipient can return for this interaction.

interactionClass.name: DataR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge either a) a DataQueryR interaction (in which case the DataR interaction contains the results of the query) or b) a SetDataR interaction (in which case the DataR interaction contains the data that the federate was able to set).

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for a transaction

interactionClass.name: DataQuery
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to request that a federate supply the current values of specified data.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient of the interaction.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Request ID is a monotonically increasing integer identifier inserted by the Simulation Manager into all Simulation management interactions. It is used as a unique identifier to identify the latest in a series of competing requests and identifying acknowledgements.

parameter.name: TimeInterval
parameter.semantics: The interval between regular updates of the requested data. If this field is zero then the recipient should only issue a single Data interaction in response to this interaction.

parameter.name: FixedDatumIdentifiers
parameter.semantics: The set of fixed length data items (types) that the recipient is requested to supply data for.

parameter.name: VariableDatumIdentifiers
parameter.semantics: The set of variable length data items (types) that the recipient is requested to supply data for.

interactionClass.name: DataQueryR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to request that a federate supply the current values of specified data. The Simulation Manager federate specifies the acknowledgement protocol to be used.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for a transaction

interactionClass.name: EventReport
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to allow a federate to alert a Simulation Manager federate that a particular event has occurred.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient(s) of the interaction.

parameter.name: EventType
parameter.semantics: The type of event being reported.

parameter.name: FixedDatums
parameter.semantics: The set of fixed size data items (types and values) associated with this event.

parameter.name: VariableDatumSet
parameter.semantics: The set of variable size data items (types and values) associated with this event.

interactionClass.name: RemoveEntity
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager to request that a specified entity be removed from the simulation.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient(s) of the interaction.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Request ID is a monotonically increasing integer identifier inserted by the Simulation Manager into all Simulation management interactions. It is used as a unique identifier to identify the latest in a series of competing requests and identifying acknowledgements.

interactionClass.name: RemoveEntityR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager to request that a specified entity be removed from the simulation.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for a transaction

interactionClass.name: SetData
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to request that a federate sets the values of specified data to specified values.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient of the interaction.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Request ID is a monotonically increasing integer identifier inserted by the Simulation Manager into all Simulation management interactions. It is used as a unique identifier to identify the latest in a series of competing requests and identifying acknowledgements.

parameter.name: FixedDatums
parameter.semantics: The set of fixed length data items (types and values) that the recipient is requested to set.

parameter.name: VariableDatumSet
parameter.semantics: The set of variables length data items (types and values) that the recipient is requested to set.

interactionClass.name: SetDataR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to request that a federate sets the values of specified data to specified values. The Simulation Manager federate specifies the acknowledgement protocol to be used.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for a transaction

interactionClass.name: StartResume
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to either a) start simulating one or more entities or b) resume simulation of one or more entities after a pause.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient(s) of the interaction.

parameter.name: RealWorldTime
parameter.semantics: The real world time (GMT) that the entity or entities should start/resume at.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Request ID is a monotonically increasing integer identifier inserted by the Simulation Manager into all Simulation management interactions. It is used as a unique identifier to identify the latest in a series of competing requests and identifying acknowledgements.

parameter.name: SimulationTime
parameter.semantics: The simulation time that the entity or entities should use when they start/resume.

interactionClass.name: StartResumeR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to either a) start simulating one or more entities or b) resume simulation of one or more entities after a pause. The Simulation Manager federate specifies the acknowledgement protocol to be used.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for a transaction

interactionClass.name: StopFreeze
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to request that one or more entities either a) freeze (pause) their simulation or b) stop their simulation.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient(s) of the interaction.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Request ID is a monotonically increasing integer identifier inserted by the Simulation Manager into all Simulation management interactions. It is used as a unique identifier to identify the latest in a series of competing requests and identifying acknowledgements.

parameter.name: RealWorldTime
parameter.semantics: The real world time (GMT) that the entity or entities should stop/freeze at.

parameter.name: Reason
parameter.semantics: The reason for the stop or freeze.

parameter.name: ReflectValues
parameter.semantics: Whether the entity or entities being stopped/frozen should continue to reflect values when stopped/frozen.

parameter.name: RunInternalSimulationClock
parameter.semantics: Whether the entity or entities being stopped/frozen should continue to run their internal simulation clock when stopped/frozen.

parameter.name: UpdateAttributes
parameter.semantics: Whether the entity or entities being stopped/frozen should continue to update attributes when stopped/frozen.

interactionClass.name: StopFreezeR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to request that one or more entities either a) pause their simulation or b) stop their simulation. The Simulation Manager federate specifies the acknowledgement protocol to be used.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for a transaction

interactionClass.name: RecordR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of a RecordQueryR or SetRecordR interaction from a Simulation Manager federate and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the federate has implemented the request.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient of the interaction.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: This field matches this response with the specific RecordQueryR or SetRecordR interaction sent by the simulation manager.

parameter.name: EventType
parameter.semantics: The type of event that caused the RecordR interaction to be issued.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for the transaction

parameter.name: ResponseSerialNumber
parameter.semantics: Used to identify the serial number of the RecordR interaction when more than one interaction is used to report record values.

parameter.name: RecordSetData
parameter.semantics: The set of records containing the information requested

interactionClass.name: RecordQueryR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to allow a Simulation Manager federate to request data, in record format, from another federate.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient(s) of the interaction.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Request ID is a monotonically increasing integer identifier inserted by the Simulation Manager into all Simulation management interactions. It is used as a unique identifier to identify the latest in a series of competing requests and identifying acknowledgements.

parameter.name: TimeInterval
parameter.semantics: The interval between regular updates of the requested data. If this field is zero then the recipient should only issue a single RecordR interaction in response to this interaction.

parameter.name: EventType
parameter.semantics: Specifies the type of event that the receiving entity or application should use to trigger the issue of a RecordR interaction in response to this query. If this is zero, then reporting shall be periodic based upon the value of the TimeInterval parameter.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for the transaction

parameter.name: RecordIdentifiers
parameter.semantics: Identifies the records for which information is requested

interactionClass.name: SetRecordR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to request that a federate sets the values of specified data to specified values (provided in record format).

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient(s) of the interaction.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Request ID is a monotonically increasing integer identifier inserted by the Simulation Manager into all Simulation management interactions. It is used as a unique identifier to identify the latest in a series of competing requests and identifying acknowledgements.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for a transaction

parameter.name: RecordSetData
parameter.semantics: Specifies the information, in record format, to be set by the receiving entity.

interactionClass.name: TransferControl
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent to initiate the transfer of control of an entity.

parameter.name: OriginatingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application sending the interaction.

parameter.name: ReceivingEntity
parameter.semantics: The DIS entity ID of the entity or application which is the intended recipient(s) of the interaction.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Request ID is a monotonically increasing integer identifier inserted by the Simulation Manager into all Simulation management interactions. It is used as a unique identifier to identify the latest in a series of competing requests and identifying acknowledgements.

parameter.name: TransferType
parameter.semantics: The type of transfer to be performed.

parameter.name: TransferEntity
parameter.semantics: The ID of the object to be transferred.

parameter.name: RecordSetData
parameter.semantics: Specifies the information, in record format, to be set by the receiving entity.

interactionClass.name: AttributeChangeRequest
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to ask that a specified attribute be set to a specified value.

parameter.name: ObjectIdentifiers
parameter.semantics: The list of objects that are the intended recipients of this interaction.

parameter.name: AttributeValueSet
parameter.semantics: The set of attributes and their values, that the recipients are asked to update.

interactionClass.name: AttributeChangeRequestR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to ask that a specified attribute be set to a specified value. The Simulation Manager federate specifies the acknowledgement protocol to be used.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for a transaction

interactionClass.name: AttributeChangeResult
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of an AttributeChangeRequest interaction from a Simulation Manager federate, and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the attribute was set to the specified value or not.

parameter.name: ObjectIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The ID of the object replying to the AttributeChangeRequest interaction.

parameter.name: AttributeChangeResult
parameter.semantics: Indicates ability to comply.

parameter.name: AttributeValueSet
parameter.semantics: The set of attributes and their values that the recipient has been able to update.

interactionClass.name: AttributeChangeResultR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of an AttributeChangeRequest interaction from a Simulation Manager federate, and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the attribute was set to the specified value or not. The Simulation Manager federate specifies the acknowledgement protocol to be used.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for this transaction

interactionClass.name: CreateObjectRequest
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to another federate requesting that it create an object instance of a particular type.

parameter.name: ObjectClass
parameter.semantics: The class of object to be created.

parameter.name: AttributeValueSet
parameter.semantics: The set of attributes, and associated values, to be used to initialize the object.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Request ID is a monotonically increasing integer identifier inserted by the Simulation Manager into all Simulation management interactions. It is used as a unique identifier to identify the latest in a series of competing requests and identifying acknowledgements.

interactionClass.name: CreateObjectRequestR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager federate to another federate requesting that it create an object instance of a particular type. The Simulation Manager federate specifies the acknowledgement protocol to be used.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for a transaction

interactionClass.name: CreateObjectResult
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of a CreateObjectRequest from a Simulation Manager federate and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the object creation was successful or not.

parameter.name: CreateObjectResult
parameter.semantics: Indicates ability to comply.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: This field matches this response with the specific CreateObject interaction sent by the simulation manager.

interactionClass.name: CreateObjectResultR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of a CreateObjectRequest from a Simulation Manager federate and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the object creation was successful or not. The Simulation Manager federate specifies the acknowledgement protocol to be used.

interactionClass.name: RemoveObjectRequest
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager to request that one or more specified objects be removed from the simulation.

parameter.name: ObjectIdentifiers
parameter.semantics: The IDs of the objects to be removed.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Request ID is a monotonically increasing integer identifier inserted by the Simulation Manager into all Simulation management interactions. It is used as a unique identifier to identify the latest in a series of competing requests and identifying acknowledgements.

interactionClass.name: RemoveObjectRequestR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction, sent from a Simulation Manager to request that one or more specified objects be removed from the simulation.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for a transaction

interactionClass.name: RemoveObjectResult
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of a RemoveObjectRequest interaction, and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the removal was successful or not.

parameter.name: RemoveObjectResult
parameter.semantics: Indicates ability to comply.

parameter.name: RequestIdentifier
parameter.semantics: This field matches this response with the specific RemoveObject interaction sent by the simulation manager.

interactionClass.name: RemoveObjectResultR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of a RemoveObjectRequestR interaction, and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the removal was successful or not.

interactionClass.name: ActionRequestToObject
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction sent from a Simulation Manager federate to one or more specific object instances to request that they perform a specified action.

parameter.name: ObjectIdentifiers
parameter.semantics: The list of objects that are the intended recipients of this interaction.

parameter.name: ActionRequestCode
parameter.semantics: The action that the recipient(s) are intended to perform.

interactionClass.name: ActionRequestToObjectR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction sent from a Simulation Manager federate to one or more specific object instances to request that they perform a specified action. The Simulation Manager federate specifies the acknowledgement protocol to be used.

parameter.name: AcknowledgementProtocol
parameter.semantics: The acknowledgement protocol to be used for this transaction

interactionClass.name: ActionResponseFromObject
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of an ActionResponseToObject interaction from a Simulation Manager federate and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the object has implemented the request.

parameter.name: ActionResult
parameter.semantics: The status of the request that the recipient has been asked to perform.

interactionClass.name: ActionResponseFromObjectR
interactionClass.semantics: A Simulation Management (SIMAN) interaction designed to acknowledge receipt of an ActionResponseToObjectR interaction from a Simulation Manager federate and to inform the Simulation Manager federate whether the object has implemented the request.

interactionClass.name: AcousticTransient
interactionClass.semantics: Specifies the occurrence of a transient acoustic event such as torpedo tube floodings, hatch slams, and wrench drops.

parameter.name: ActivityCode
parameter.semantics: Index into a data base of transient acoustic events

parameter.name: ActivityParameter
parameter.semantics: The current state of the activity specified by the activity code

parameter.name: HostObjectIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Object Instance ID of the object emitting the sound

parameter.name: RelativePosition
parameter.semantics: The location of the sound relative to the hosts coordinate system

interactionClass.name: WeaponFire
interactionClass.semantics: Communicates information associated with the firing or launch of a munition.

parameter.name: EventIdentifier
parameter.semantics: An ID, generated by the issuing federate, used to associate related fire and detonation events.

parameter.name: FireControlSolutionRange
parameter.semantics: The range used in the fire control solution. Zero if the range is unknown or inapplicable.

parameter.name: FireMissionIndex
parameter.semantics: A unique index to identify the fire mission (used to associate weapon fire interactions in a single fire mission).

parameter.name: FiringLocation
parameter.semantics: The location, in world coordinates, from which the munition was launched.

parameter.name: FiringObjectIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The object instance ID of the entity firing the munition.

parameter.name: FuseType
parameter.semantics: The type of fuse on the munition.

parameter.name: InitialVelocityVector
parameter.semantics: The velocity vector of the munition when fired.

parameter.name: MunitionObjectIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The object instance ID of the fired munition, if an object instance is registered.

parameter.name: MunitionType
parameter.semantics: The type of munition being fired.

parameter.name: QuantityFired
parameter.semantics: The number of rounds fired in the burst.

parameter.name: RateOfFire
parameter.semantics: The rate of fire in rounds per minute when quantity > 1. Zero otherwise.

parameter.name: TargetObjectIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The object instance ID of the intended target (if any).

parameter.name: WarheadType
parameter.semantics: The type of warhead fitted to the munition being fired.

interactionClass.name: MunitionDetonation
interactionClass.semantics: Communicates information associated with the impact or detonation of a munition

parameter.name: ArticulatedPartData
parameter.semantics: The set of articulated parts affected by the detonation (including where on the articulated part the detonation has affected).

parameter.name: DetonationLocation
parameter.semantics: The location, in world coordinates, at which the munition detonated.

parameter.name: DetonationResultCode
parameter.semantics: The type of detonation (including no detonation).

parameter.name: EventIdentifier
parameter.semantics: An ID, generated by the issuing federate, used to associate related fire and detonation events.

parameter.name: FiringObjectIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The object instance ID of the entity that fired the munition.

parameter.name: FinalVelocityVector
parameter.semantics: The velocity vector of the munition at the moment of the detonation.

parameter.name: FuseType
parameter.semantics: The type of fuse on the munition.

parameter.name: MunitionObjectIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The Object instance ID of the fired munition, if an object instance is registered.

parameter.name: MunitionType
parameter.semantics: The type of munition that is detonating.

parameter.name: QuantityFired
parameter.semantics: The number of rounds fired in the burst.

parameter.name: RateOfFire
parameter.semantics: The rate of fire in rounds per minute when quantity > 1. Zero otherwise.

parameter.name: RelativeDetonationLocation
parameter.semantics: The location of the detonation in coordinates relative to the target entity (if any).

parameter.name: TargetObjectIdentifier
parameter.semantics: The object instance ID of the entity that the munition has detonated on (if any).

parameter.name: WarheadType
parameter.semantics: The type of warhead on the munition.

interactionClass.name: ETR_Root
interactionClass.semantics: Root interaction class for the Entitiy Tasking and Reporting (ETR) interaction classes.

interactionClass.name: ETR_Task
interactionClass.semantics: A base interaction class for more specialized task interaction classes.

parameter.name: TaskId
parameter.semantics: Required. Uniqie identifier for the task.

parameter.name: Taskee
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to the entity that will execute the task.

parameter.name: Tasker
parameter.semantics: Optional. Callsign of the commander of the task. If missing, the commander is undefined.

parameter.name: StartWhen
parameter.semantics: Required. Time when the task execution should start. Use the value 00000000000000.000 to indicate that the time is undefined.

parameter.name: Why
parameter.semantics: Optional. A text describing the reason for this task.

parameter.name: TaskMode
parameter.semantics: Required. Determines the task mode.

parameter.name: CommunicationNetworkIds
parameter.semantics: Optional. Reference to communication networks (NETN-COM) used to transfer tasking messages. If not provided, the task transmission should not be modelled and federates should receive and act on the task messages directly.

interactionClass.name: SendSafetyRelatedMessage
interactionClass.semantics:
Tasks entity (the source) to send a safety related message (AIS message type 12) to another entity (the destination).
Both source and destination must represent an AIS station (vessel, SAR aircraft, etc).

parameter.name: Entity
parameter.semantics: Required. The entity that represents the destination. This must be an AIS station.

parameter.name: Message
parameter.semantics: Required. 1-156 chars of six-bit text.

interactionClass.name: SendSafetyRelatedBroadcastMessage
interactionClass.semantics:
Tasks entity (the source) to send a safety related broadcast message (AIS message type 14).
The source must represent an AIS station (vessel, SAR aircraft, etc).

parameter.name: Message
parameter.semantics: Required. 1-161 chars of six-bit text.

interactionClass.name: AddPassage
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to lay/build a passage between the two given points. The passage can, for example, be a passage through an obstacle or a bridge over a river. The tasked entity should be within a certain distance tolerance (specified in the federation agreement) of one of the points of the passage. A passage object should be registered in the federation with the provided UUID.

parameter.name: Point1
parameter.semantics: Required. The line between point1 and point2 defines the geometry of the passage.

parameter.name: Point2
parameter.semantics: Required. The line between point1 and point2 defines the geometry of the passage.

parameter.name: UniqueId
parameter.semantics: Required. A unique UUID of the passage.

interactionClass.name: ClearObstacle
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to clear an obstacle or minefield with the given UUID. The tasked entity should be within a certain distance (tolerance specified in the federation agreement) of one of the points of the geometry of the obstacle.

parameter.name: UniqueId
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to the Obstacle to clear.

interactionClass.name: CreateObstacle
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to create an obstacle with the given geometry. The tasked entity should be within a certain distance (tolerance specified in the federation agreement) of one of the points of the geometry.

parameter.name: UniqueId
parameter.semantics: Required. A unique UUID of the Obstacle.

parameter.name: ObstacleType
parameter.semantics: Required. The type of the obstacle defined by the entity type of the obstacle (SISO REF-010 Land Culture Features) .

parameter.name: Geometry
parameter.semantics: Required. Area of the obstacle.

interactionClass.name: CreateMinefield
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to create a minefield within the specified geometry. When the task is completed, a minefield object should be published in the federation (e.g. RPR-FOM Minefield). This tasking interaction is different from the RPR-FOM MinefieldObjectTransaction interaction, which asks a federate to create a minefield magically.

parameter.name: TypeOfMines
parameter.semantics: Required. Type of mines used defined in SISO-REF-010.

parameter.name: MineCount_MineDensity
parameter.semantics: Required. Count or density of mines.

interactionClass.name: Dismount
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to dismount from a mounted position. When the task is completed, the tasked entity is no longer attached to or embarked in another entity.

interactionClass.name: DisruptCommunication
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to introduce a communication network disruption.

parameter.name: AffectedCommunicationNetwork
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to the affected Communication Network. If not provided all communication networks are affected.

parameter.name: AffectedArea
parameter.semantics: Required. Area affected by disruption.

parameter.name: DisruptionEnabled
parameter.semantics: Required. Disruption enabled or disabled. Default is True = Enabled.

interactionClass.name: EstablishCheckPoint
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to establish a checkpoint. The task defines a location where a checkpoint shall be established and then operated. The tasked entity should be within a certain distance (tolerance specified in the federation agreements) of the location of the checkpoint. If not, a separate move task should be issued first. During the execution of the task, a CheckPoint object (NETN-SE) should be registered in the federation. The completion and operational status of the CheckPoint object should be updated continuously during the execution of the task or at task completion. Immediately after the checkpoint has been established, it will be operated by the tasked entity for a specified duration of time.

parameter.name: Name
parameter.semantics: Required. The name of the Check Point.

parameter.name: Location
parameter.semantics: Required. The location of the Check Point.

parameter.name: UniqueId
parameter.semantics: Required. Unique identifier for the SE_CheckPoint object to be created as a result of this task.

parameter.name: Duration
parameter.semantics: Required. The duration of the initial operation of the Check Point after it has been established.

parameter.name: LocationUuid
parameter.semantics: Optional. The location for the checkpoint by reference to NETN-SE SE_GeoObject.

interactionClass.name: FireAtEntity
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to fire at another specified target entity.

parameter.name: Target
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to the target entity.

interactionClass.name: FireAtEntityWM
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to fire at a specified target entity with the specified weapon and munition data.

parameter.name: WeaponTypeToUse
parameter.semantics: Required. Preferd weapon type.

parameter.name: MunitionTypeToUse
parameter.semantics: Required. Prefered munition type.

parameter.name: QuantityFired
parameter.semantics: Required. Number of rounds.

parameter.name: RateOfFire
parameter.semantics: Required. Number of rounds per second.

interactionClass.name: FireAtLocation
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to fire at a location.

parameter.name: Location
parameter.semantics: Required. The location to fire at.

parameter.name: Duration
parameter.semantics: Required. The duration of the fire (seconds).

parameter.name: LocationUuid
parameter.semantics: Optional. The location to fire at by reference to a NETN SE, SE_GeoObject.

interactionClass.name: FireAtLocationWM
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to fire at a location with the specified weapon and munition.

parameter.name: WeaponTypeToUse
parameter.semantics: Required. Preferd weapon type.

parameter.name: MunitionTypeToUse
parameter.semantics: Required. Prefered muntion type.

parameter.name: QuantityFired
parameter.semantics: Required. Number of rounds to fire

parameter.name: RateOfFire
parameter.semantics: Required. Number of rounds per second.

interactionClass.name: FollowEntity
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to follow another entity at a specified distance.

parameter.name: Entity
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to the entity to follow.

parameter.name: Behind
parameter.semantics: Required. The distance in meters behind the entity to follow.

parameter.name: Right
parameter.semantics: Required. The distance in meters to the right of the entity to follow.

parameter.name: Above
parameter.semantics: Required. The distance in meters above the entity to follow.

parameter.name: Duration
parameter.semantics: Required. The duration of the follow action (seconds).

interactionClass.name: Move
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to move in a specified direction for a given duration of time.

parameter.name: Direction
parameter.semantics: Required. Direction of movement (azimuth direction).

parameter.name: Duration
parameter.semantics: Required. The duration of the move.

interactionClass.name: MoveIntoFormation
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to move into the given formation on the given location with the given heading.

parameter.name: Formation
parameter.semantics: Required. The type of positional arrangement the entity.

parameter.name: Location
parameter.semantics: Required. The location to move to.

parameter.name: Distance
parameter.semantics: Required. The minimum distance between entities in the formation.

parameter.name: Heading
parameter.semantics: Required. The heading of the formation.

parameter.name: LocationUuid
parameter.semantics: Optional. The location to move to by reference to a NETN SE, SE_GeoObject.

interactionClass.name: MoveToEntity
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to move to another entity. If a path is provided, the entity should follow the path as its route to the entity. The entity should align with the path from its current position to the nearest position or waypoint on the path. The entity should leave the path at position or waypoint on the path closest to the destination entity. The entity moves directly towards the destination entity if no path (or a zero-length path) is provided.

parameter.name: Entity
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to the entity to move to.

parameter.name: Path
parameter.semantics: Optional. Route to the specified entity.

parameter.name: MoveType
parameter.semantics: Required. Indicates if roads have to be followed.

parameter.name: PathUuid
parameter.semantics: Optional. Path to use to get to the Location by reference to a NETN_SE, SE_GeoObject.

interactionClass.name: MoveToLocation
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to move to the specified destination location. If a path is provided, the entity should follow the path as its route to the destination. The entity should align with the path from its current position to the nearest position or waypoint on the path. The entity should leave the path at position or waypoint on the path closest to the destination. The entity moves directly towards the destination location if no path (or a zero-length path) is provided.

parameter.name: Location
parameter.semantics: Required. The location to move to.

parameter.name: Path
parameter.semantics: Optional. A route to use in order to move to the Location.

parameter.name: MoveType
parameter.semantics: Required. Indicates if roads have to be followed.

parameter.name: PathUuid
parameter.semantics: Optional. Path to use to get to the Location by reference to a NETN_SE, SE_GeoObject.

parameter.name: LocationUuid
parameter.semantics: Optional. The location to move to, by reference to a NETN_SE, SE_GeoObject.

interactionClass.name: Mount
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of entity to mount the specified entity. The tasked entity should be within a certain distance (tolerance specified in the federation agreements) of the location of the entity to mount.

parameter.name: EntityId
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to the entity to mount.

interactionClass.name: Observe
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to observe an area.

parameter.name: ObservationArea
parameter.semantics: Required. Area to observe.

interactionClass.name: OperateCheckPoint
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to operate a checkpoint. The tasked entity should be within a certain distance (tolerance specified in the federation agreements) of the location of the checkpoint. If not, a separate move task should be issued first. The tasked entity activates an inactive checkpoint and operates the checkpoint for the specified duration of time.

parameter.name: UniqueId
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to the checkpoint to operate.

parameter.name: Duration
parameter.semantics: Required. The duration of the operation of the checkpoint.

interactionClass.name: Patrol
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to perform a patrol. The tasked entity moves from its current position to the start of the patrol route and then moves according to patrol route from its start point in the path, through all waypoints.

parameter.name: Path
parameter.semantics: Required. Specifies the route to patrol.

parameter.name: PatrolType
parameter.semantics: Required. Defines how the patrol should be excuted. The full movement from start point, through the patrol route and back to the start point is called one cycle.

parameter.name: MoveType
parameter.semantics: Required. Defines how the entity shall move during the patrol route.

parameter.name: PathUuid
parameter.semantics: Optional. Path for the patrol by reference to a NETN_SE, SE_GeoObject.

interactionClass.name: PatrolRepeating
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to repeat a patrol for a given duration. When the duration time has passed, then the last cycle of the patrol is completed before the task ends. If the time of a cycle takes longer then the interval time, then the cycle starts directly (without delay). If the time of a cycle takes less then the interval time, then the entity waits at the first point of the patrol route until the next cycle is started.

parameter.name: Duration
parameter.semantics: Required. The duration of the total patrol task.

parameter.name: IntervalTime
parameter.semantics: Required. The time between the start of two cycles, i.e. the time to complete a cycle and any waiting time before starting the next cycle.

interactionClass.name: RemoveCheckPoint
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to remove a checkpoint. This task removes a previously established checkpoint. The tasked entity should be within a certain distance (tolerance specified in the federation agreements) of the location of the checkpoint. If not, a separate move task should be issued first. After completion of the task, the checkpoint object should be deleted from the federation.

parameter.name: UniqueId
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to the CheckPoint to remove.

interactionClass.name: RemovePassage
interactionClass.semantics: Task entity to remove the passage with the given UUID. The tasked entity should be within a certain distance tolerance (specified in the federation agreement) of one of the points of the passage to make the task possible.

parameter.name: UniqueId
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to a A unique UUID of the passage.

interactionClass.name: SetOrderedAltitude
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to set move to specified altitude.

parameter.name: Altitude
parameter.semantics: Required. Defines the altitude.

parameter.name: AltitudeType
parameter.semantics: Required. Above the ground or sea.

interactionClass.name: SetOrderedSpeed
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to change speed.

parameter.name: Speed
parameter.semantics: Required. Determines the ordered speed to set for an entity, in m/s.

interactionClass.name: SetRulesOfEngagement
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to change its rules of engagement.

parameter.name: RulesOfEngagement
parameter.semantics: Required. Determines the rules of engagment for a entity.

interactionClass.name: SetTransmitterStatus
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to switch on/off all of its transmitters.

parameter.name: Status
parameter.semantics: Required. Status on the transmitter.

interactionClass.name: StopAtSideOfRoad
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to stop at the side of the road. This task is only relevant for an entity that is moving along a road to a destination. The executing move task is cancelled, and a new move is defined towards a position at the side of the road (the simulator has to calculate this location).

interactionClass.name: TurnToHeading
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to turn to the specified heading.

parameter.name: Heading
parameter.semantics: Required. The heading an entity has to turn to.

interactionClass.name: TurnToOrientation
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to rotate to a specified orientation, including pitch and roll.

parameter.name: Pitch
parameter.semantics: Required. Defines the angle ot the pitch.

parameter.name: Roll
parameter.semantics: Required. Defines the angle ot the roll.

interactionClass.name: Wait
interactionClass.semantics: Tasking of an entity to wait for a duration of time.

parameter.name: Duration
parameter.semantics: Required. Specifies the wait time (seconds).

interactionClass.name: ETR_Report
interactionClass.semantics: A base interaction class for more specialized report interaction classes.

parameter.name: ReportId
parameter.semantics: Required. Uniqie identifier for the report.

parameter.name: When
parameter.semantics: Required. Date and time when the reported status was valid.

parameter.name: CommunicationNetworkIds
parameter.semantics: Optional. Reference to communication networks (NETN-COM) used to transfer report messages. If not provided, the report transmission should not be modelled and federates should receive and act on the report messages directly.

parameter.name: Comments
parameter.semantics: Optional. Any additional comments associated with the report.

interactionClass.name: InWeaponRangeReport
interactionClass.semantics: Report on a unit's ability to reach specific targets with its weapon systems.

parameter.name: Observer
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to the entity that observed another entity in range of its weapons.

parameter.name: WeaponType
parameter.semantics: Required. The type of the weapon that is in range.

parameter.name: EntitiesInWeaponRange
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to entities in rage of the weapon.

interactionClass.name: SpotReport
interactionClass.semantics: Report on a unit's awareness of spotted entities.

parameter.name: Observer
parameter.semantics: Required. Entity that observed the enemy (or neutral/unknown entity) and sends the spot report.

parameter.name: IdentificationLevel
parameter.semantics: Required. The identification level of the entit(y)(ies) spotted.

parameter.name: SpottedEntities
parameter.semantics: Required. Spotted entities at the time specified in the parameter 'When'.

interactionClass.name: SensorReport
interactionClass.semantics: Report on a unit's sensor detection of entities.

parameter.name: SensorType
parameter.semantics: Required. The type of the sensor that detected the entities.

interactionClass.name: StatusReport
interactionClass.semantics: Report on a unit's own (perceived) state. This report should be generated with a frequency specified in the federation agreements.

parameter.name: EntityId
parameter.semantics: Required. The entity that is reported about.

interactionClass.name: DamageStatusReport
interactionClass.semantics: Report on a unit's damage status.

parameter.name: DamageType
parameter.semantics: Required. Damage state of the reported entity.

interactionClass.name: PositionStatusReport
interactionClass.semantics: Report on a unit's position, speed, and heading.

parameter.name: Position
parameter.semantics: Required. Position of the entity at the specified time.

parameter.name: Heading
parameter.semantics: Required. Heading of the entity.

parameter.name: Speed
parameter.semantics: Required. Speed of the entity.

interactionClass.name: ResourceStatusReport
interactionClass.semantics: Report on a unit's remaining amount resources.

parameter.name: Resource
parameter.semantics: Required. The type of resource and remaining quantity.

interactionClass.name: UnderAttackStatusReport
interactionClass.semantics: Report from a unit that it is under attack.

parameter.name: FromDirection
parameter.semantics: Required. Direction from which the entity is attacked, between 0..2π or -1 when not specified.

parameter.name: Severeness
parameter.semantics: Required. Severeness of the attack upon the reporting entity.

interactionClass.name: ETR_SimCon
interactionClass.semantics: A base interaction class for EXCON Task interaction classes.

parameter.name: TaskId
parameter.semantics: Required. Uniqie identifier for the simulation control task.

parameter.name: Taskee
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to the entity that should execute the task.

parameter.name: Tasker
parameter.semantics: Optional. Indentifies the commander of the task.

interactionClass.name: CapabilitiesSupported
interactionClass.semantics: Provides the set of ETR_Task, ETR_SimCon and ETR_Report interactions that the federate modelling the entity supports. This interaction is in response to a QuerySupportedCapabilities.

parameter.name: CapabilityNames
parameter.semantics: Required. Array of task and report names that the entity supports; the names match with the FOM class names of NETN-ETR Tasks, Reports and SimCon interactions.

interactionClass.name: MagicMove
interactionClass.semantics: A simulation control task that instructs the entity to immediately jump to the specified location and update the new position and heading.

parameter.name: Location
parameter.semantics: Required. Location of the entity.

parameter.name: Heading
parameter.semantics: Required. Heading of the entity.

parameter.name: LocationUuid
parameter.semantics: Optional. The new location for the entity. Refered by a UUID.

interactionClass.name: MagicResource
interactionClass.semantics: A simulation control task that instructs the entity to set amount of available resources immediately

parameter.name: Resource
parameter.semantics: Required. Defines the resource type that will get a new quantity value.

interactionClass.name: QuerySupportedCapabilities
interactionClass.semantics: Query which tasks, reports and SimCon actions that an entity supports. The queried entity shall respond with a CapabilitiesSupported message.

interactionClass.name: ETR_TaskManagement
interactionClass.semantics: A base interaction class for more specialized task management interaction classes.

parameter.name: TaskManagementId
parameter.semantics: Required. Uniqie identifier for the management task.

parameter.name: Taskee
parameter.semantics: Required. Reference to the entity that should execute the task.

parameter.name: Tasker
parameter.semantics: Optional. Identifies the commander of the task.

parameter.name: CommunicationNetworkIds
parameter.semantics: Optional. Reference to communication networks (NETN-COM) used to transfer task management messages. If not provided, the message transmission should not be modelled and federates should receive and act on the task management messages directly.

interactionClass.name: CancelAllTasks
interactionClass.semantics: Management task to an entity to cancel all queued and ongoing tasks.

interactionClass.name: CancelSpecifiedTasks
interactionClass.semantics: Management task to an entity to cancel all specified tasks.

parameter.name: Tasks
parameter.semantics: Required. Tasks that should be cancelled.

interactionClass.name: TaskStatusReport
interactionClass.semantics: A management task report regarding the status of a specific task assigned to an entity.

parameter.name: TaskId
parameter.semantics: Required. Identifies the task associated with the task report.

parameter.name: TaskStatus
parameter.semantics: Required. Indicates the status of the task.

parameter.name: When
parameter.semantics: Required. Creation date and time of the report.

parameter.name: Comments
parameter.semantics: Optional. Any additional comments. For example reason for cancelling, errors, etc.

interactionClass.name: CBRN_Casualty
interactionClass.semantics: Represents a CBRN casualty caused by exposure. This is for use with federates that cannot support the TriageLevel attribute in CBRN_Human.

parameter.name: UniqueID
parameter.semantics: Unique representation of the entity’s ID.

parameter.name: TriageLevel
parameter.semantics: Triage level of this entity.

parameter.name: Exposures
parameter.semantics: Array of agents to which this unit has been exposed.

interactionClass.name: CBRN_PlatformUpdate
interactionClass.semantics: Represents an update to the contaminating mass inside a vehicle due to embedded entities.

parameter.name: PlatformID
parameter.semantics: The unique ID of the platform.

parameter.name: Contamination
parameter.semantics: New state of CBRN hazardous agent inside vehicle due to embedded units.

interactionClass.name: CBRN_Release
interactionClass.semantics: Communicates information associated with the release of hazardous agent.

parameter.name: UniqueID
parameter.semantics: Unique representation of the release’s ID.

parameter.name: Agent
parameter.semantics: The type of released CBRN hazardous agent.

parameter.name: Location
parameter.semantics: Initial location of the release in the geocentric location system.

parameter.name: Mass
parameter.semantics: Total released agent mass in kg.

parameter.name: Duration
parameter.semantics: Duration in seconds over which the release takes place.

parameter.name: ReleaseSize
parameter.semantics: The initial size of the release including initial Gaussian sigmas of the released puff and mean & variance of released particles.

parameter.name: ReleaseDynamics
parameter.semantics: Temperature differance and density ratio of released material relative to the atmosphere.

parameter.name: ReleaseVelocity
parameter.semantics: Velocity of the source term.

interactionClass.name: CBRN_FacilityUpdate
interactionClass.semantics: Represents an order for the specified entities to enter or leave the CBRN facility.

parameter.name: FacilityID
parameter.semantics: The unique ID of the CBRN facility.

parameter.name: EmbeddedUnitList
parameter.semantics: List of unique IDs of the entities who will enter or exit the CBRN facility.

parameter.name: IsEntry
parameter.semantics: Determines whether the entities are entering (IsEntry = true) or exiting (IsEntry = false) the CBRN facility.

interactionClass.name: COLPROUpdate
interactionClass.semantics: Represents an order for the specified entities to enter or leave the COLPRO.

interactionClass.name: DecontaminationStationUpdate
interactionClass.semantics: Represents an order for the specified entities to enter or leave the decontamination station.

interactionClass.name: IPECommand
interactionClass.semantics: Represents an order for the specified entities to don protective equipment.

parameter.name: UnitList
parameter.semantics: List of unique IDs of the entities who will don IPE.

parameter.name: IPEType
parameter.semantics: Type of IPE that the entities will don.

interactionClass.name: CBRN_TreatmentCommand
interactionClass.semantics: Represents an order for the specified entities to receive the list of treatments.

parameter.name: UnitList
parameter.semantics: List of unique IDs of the entities who will receive the treatment.

parameter.name: Treatments
parameter.semantics: Type of treatment to be applied to the entities.

interactionClass.name: CBRN_DetectorAlarm
interactionClass.semantics: Represents the alarm trigger of a previously registered CBRN detector.

parameter.name: DetectorID
parameter.semantics: Unique representation of the detector’s ID.

parameter.name: Alarm
parameter.semantics: Details of the alarm.

interactionClass.name: CBRN_SensorUpdate
interactionClass.semantics: Sends information about the current state of a previously registered CBRN sensor.

parameter.name: Time
parameter.semantics: Time of this sensor update

parameter.name: SensorID
parameter.semantics: Unique representation of the sensor’s ID.

parameter.name: Readings
parameter.semantics: Readings for this sensor

interactionClass.name: LOG_Interaction
interactionClass.semantics: Base class for all NETN Logistics Pattern Service Transactions.

parameter.name: RequestId
parameter.semantics: Required: Unique identifier for the requested service related to the transaction.

interactionClass.name: RequestService
interactionClass.semantics: A consumer federate initiates service negotiation using `RequestService`. A unique ServiceId and a reference to a `ConsumerEntity` are required parameters.
